jobs.title: Java/ Kotlin developer
jobs.description:
Datakoppelingen bouwen waar duizenden Rechtspraakmedewerkers op vertrouwen? Dat doe je als Java/Kotlin developer bij IVO Rechtspraak, de IV/IT\-dienstverlener van de Rechtspraak. Je haalt cruciale gegevens veilig en razendsnel uit verschillende systemen en zorgt dat ze terechtkomen waar ze nodig zijn. Met Java, Kotlin en innovatieve integratietechnologie werk je aan de digitale infrastructuur van de Rechtspraak. Superbelangrijk dus!

**Wat ga je doen bij IVO Rechtspraak?**
---------------------------------------


Jij versterkt team TEC, het data\- en integratieteam dat systemen binnen de Rechtspraak met elkaar laat praten. Als Java/Kotlin developer bouw jij de datakoppelingen die dat mogelijk maken. Soms komt de informatie voor één toepassing uit vijf of zes verschillende bronnen. Daar zit de grote puzzel: waar haal je welke data vandaan, hoe breng je die goed bij elkaar en hoe zorg je dat andere teams ermee verder kunnen?


Het aantal datavragen groeit. Collega\-teams kloppen vaker bij TEC aan en de lat ligt hoog: gegevens moeten soms binnen een paar seconden beschikbaar zijn. Voor jou betekent dat technisch uitdagend werk met Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, OCP, AMQ en MongoDB. Je bouwt oplossingen die een hoge snelheid aankunnen, stabiel blijven én data breed beschikbaar maken binnen de Rechtspraak.


Je werkt met zo’n acht à negen collega’s: developers, testers, ontwerpers, een product owner en scrum master. Een team waarin techniek volop onderwerp van gesprek is en je de ruimte krijgt om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. De backend is jouw basis, maar daar hoeft het niet bij te blijven. Jullie gaan bijvoorbeeld ook schermen bouwen voor het beheren en raadplegen van referentiegegevens. Angular al in de vingers? Mooi. Nog niet? Dan kun je het hier leren.


Is data\-integratie helemaal jouw ding? En vind je het leuk om samen te werken met collega’s die net zo van technologie houden als jij? Dan zit je goed bij TEC: een technisch gedreven club waar kennis delen en samen nieuwe dingen uitproberen vanzelfsprekend zijn.

**Dit krijg je ervoor terug**
-----------------------------


Om te beginnen een leuke, informele werksfeer. We houden de lijnen graag kort! En je arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn prima geregeld volgens de CAO Rijk. Wat belangrijke punten op een rij:

* Contract: een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 36 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
* Salaris: je komt terecht in salarisschaal 10 of 11 (maximaal € 6\.275,94 per maand bij een werkweek van 36 uur). Inschaling vindt plaats op basis van je werkervaring.
* Keuzebudget: 16,5% van je jaarsalaris (maximaal € 1\.008 per maand) om je eigen arbeidsvoorwaarden samen te stellen. Zoals het kopen van verlof, het aanschaffen van een fiets of het verduurzamen van je woning.
* Doorgroeimogelijkheden: je functie zit vol mogelijkheden om je kennis verder uit te breiden en je persoonlijke ontwikkeling te stimuleren. En bij onze IVO Academie kun je allerlei trainingen en opleidingen doen.
* Werk\-privébalans: je bent vrij om je werkdagen flexibel in te delen. Zo kun je deels vanuit huis werken. We dragen € 750 bij aan het inrichten van een comfortabele thuiswerkplek.
* Vakanties en vrije dagen: je hebt 144 vakantie\- en 64 keuzebudget\-uren op basis van een 36\-urige werkweek. Dat zijn dus in totaal 26 dagen.
* Gratis OV: je krijgt van ons een OV\-chipkaart voor je woon\-werkverkeer.
* Pensioen: je bouwt je pensioen op bij het ABP, een van de grootste pensioenfondsen van Nederland. Ook dat is dus goed geregeld.
* Leuke activiteiten: een teamdag, borrelmiddagen, een after summer\-feest … er gebeurt van alles. Of organiseer ook zelf iets met je collega’s, van padel tot yoga of een pubquiz.

Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden vind je op www.p\-direkt.nl.

**Wat we van jou verwachten**
-----------------------------

* 4 à 5 jaar ervaring met Java/Kotlin binnen data\-integratie
* Ervaring met Spring Boot
* Ervaring met werken in een containeromgeving, zoals OCP
* Kennis van message brokers, zoals AMQ
* Kennis van MongoDB


Kom je bij ons werken, dan vragen we ook altijd een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag.

**Hier kom je te werken**
-------------------------


Bij IVO Rechtspraak werken rond de 1\.000 bevlogen, trotse en betrokken professionals. Samen ontwikkelen en beheren we de digitale systemen voor de rechtspraak. Zo zorgen we dat rechtszaken iedere dag soepel verlopen. Onze kernwaarde integriteit is verweven in het DNA van al onze medewerkers. Van IT’er tot communicatieadviseur of beleidsmedewerker. Daarom vinden wij het ook belangrijk dat iedereen die bij ons werkt zich thuis voelt, plezier heeft in het werk en zichzelf kan zijn in een informele werksfeer.

* **Sollicitatie**

jobs.title: DevOps Workplace Engineer
jobs.description:
350 ontwikkelaars die op jouw techniek vertrouwen. Als beheerder ontwikkelwerkplek bij IVO Rechtspraak, de IV/IT\-dienstverlener van de Rechtspraak, zorg jij dat zij ongestoord hun werk kunnen doen. Je houdt onze ontwikkelwerkplek en CI/CD\-tooling bij, lost problemen op en bouwt mee aan de werkplek van morgen. Met zoveel techniek ben je hier voorlopig niet uitgeleerd!

**Wat ga je doen bij IVO Rechtspraak?**
---------------------------------------


Op de ontwikkelwerkplek draaien zo’n 50 tools die allemaal up\-to\-date moeten zijn én goed moeten samenwerken. Jij houdt ze bij, test nieuwe images en maakt dat updates zonder problemen bij ontwikkelaars terechtkomen. Gaat er toch iets mis? Dan zoek je uit wat er aan de hand is en help je de ontwikkelaars weer op weg. Ook ga je aan de slag met CI/CD\-tooling. Zo krijg je met steeds meer onderdelen van onze ontwikkelomgeving te maken.


Ondertussen werken we aan een nieuwe generatie ontwikkelwerkplek. En daar kun jij volop aan meebouwen! Hoe richten we die in en bieden we een optimale developer experience? Welke keuzes maken we op het gebied van security, netwerken en digitale soevereiniteit? En welke techniek past het beste bij wat ontwikkelaars nodig hebben? Je onderzoekt de mogelijkheden, denkt mee over de technische keuzes en helpt nieuwe oplossingen realiseren. Daarbij krijg je alle ruimte om je eigen ideeën in te brengen.


En je team? Dat is het Ontwikkel Support Team (OST), onderdeel van onze base Platformen. Een gedreven club van zo’n 10 mensen, ieder met een eigen technisch specialisme en altijd bereid om mee te denken. Ook werk je samen met collega’s uit andere teams binnen je base, zoals de experts uit het Azure\- en OpenShift\-team. En vooral ook leuk, je hebt rechtstreeks contact met onze ontwikkelaars. Want wie weet nu beter wat zij nodig hebben dan zijzelf?

jobs.title: Developer
jobs.description:
Jij bouwt software die ertoe doet, met AI als versneller, moderne tooling en een team dat net zoveel waarde hecht aan kwaliteit als jij. Samen ontwikkelen jullie de platformen waar onze klanten elke dag op draaien.

  


##### **Jij levert software die in één keer goed is en werkt aan vernieuwende oplossingen voor onze klanten, je team en jezelf.**


Bij CODE14 zoeken we developers die applicaties visueel en functioneel tot leven brengen. Jij bouwt de gaafste en meest gebruiksvriendelijke platformen voor onze klanten. Je werkt met een moderne stack in GitLab en zet AI\-tooling als Cursor en Claude Code in om je vakmanschap te versnellen, waarbij jij altijd zelf stuurt en beoordeelt. Zo maken we samen simplifying digital complexity waar.


‍
Kwaliteit bewaken zit bij ons in elke developerrol. Je test je eigen werk en beoordeelt merge requests van collega's op codekwaliteit en functionaliteit. Ook controleer je of wat je bouwt doet wat de specificatie vraagt, zodat het in één keer door de kwaliteitspoorten gaat. Loop je ergens tegenaan, dan schakel je direct met je product manager. En zie je een slimmere oplossing? Dan laat je dat horen, gevraagd en ongevraagd. Samen met het team ga jij er elke dag vol voor, want onze klanten willen voorop lopen met tech en wij zorgen dat ze die voorsprong ook echt pakken.


‍
### **Het fundament**


Als developer ben je samen met je team verantwoordelijk voor je werk en haal je de afspraken die we maken. Je werk bestaat grofweg uit drie onderdelen.


###### **Ontwikkelen**


Samen met je team ontwikkel je nieuwe platformen en functionaliteiten, die je daarna onderhoudt en verbetert. Je kijkt ook hoe we de customer journey en de UI nog beter kunnen maken.


‍
###### **Kwaliteit**


Je beoordeelt merge requests op codekwaliteit en functionaliteit en levert werk dat in één keer goed is. Voor frontend en backend schrijf je geautomatiseerde tests, en je documentatie is op orde voordat iets naar beheer gaat. Ook denk je mee over schattingen en over het implementeren van de architectuur.


‍
###### **Vooruitdenken**


Je blijft op de hoogte van nieuwe ontwikkelingen en verkent hoe AI het bouwen verandert. Daarbij denk je altijd vanuit de eindgebruiker.


* 
Dit is wat wij jou kunnen bieden
* Salaris tussen € 3\.500 en € 5\.000 bruto per maand, op basis van 40 uur
* Een groeibudget van € 750 per jaar, zodat je blijft leren en groeien
* Parttime werken bespreken we graag met je
* Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden
* Een paar keer per jaar een hackathon waarin we onszelf flink uitdagen
* Elk jaar naar events om nieuwe kennis op te halen, vrijwel iedereen gaat minstens één keer
* Elke week een bootcamp en elke dag een heerlijke lunch op kantoor
* Teamuitjes waar we nog lang over napraten
**Onze Smart Grow Formule**
===========================


**Onze Smart Grow Formule**
===========================


Wat jij ons kan bieden
* Hbo werk\- en denkniveau, een afgeronde ICT\-opleiding is een pré
* Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring
* Je kent een paar van deze talen door en door, zoals Javascript (Vue/Nuxt), HTML, CSS en PHP
* Kennis van Laravel is een pré
* Je hebt een positieve kijk op AI en werkt er graag elke dag mee, bij ons met Cursor en Claude Code
* Je gaat voor kwaliteit, en testen en reviews horen voor jou bij het werk

Heb je minder dan 3 jaar werkervaring? Dan past onze vacature developer beheer en onderhoud beter bij jou. Daar leer je in korte tijd de volle breedte van onze software kennen.


### **Our culture**

* 
\_Zo werken we
\_01
##### **Solliciteren**


Solliciteer je? We bellen je dezelfde dag nog terug om even kennis te maken, of een videomeeting te plannen.

Als het aan ons ligt, loop je binnen twee weken na je sollicatie al een dag met ons mee. Zo kun je je mogelijke collega’s ontmoeten, maximaal sfeerproeven en leer je jezelf beter kennen met één van onze assessments.

jobs.title: Developer Beheer & Onderhoud
jobs.description:
Wil jij het developervak echt leren? Dan start je bij ons op de plek waar je in korte tijd de volle breedte van software leert kennen, bij beheer en onderhoud.

  


##### **Jij houdt de software van onze klanten veilig, actueel en draaiend en leert ondertussen het vak in de volle breedte.**


Alles wat CODE14 ooit bouwde, draait bij echte klanten en dat moet ook zo blijven. Als developer beheer en onderhoud ben jij de tweede lijn. Je pakt de meldingen op die onze service engineer doorzet en duikt in bestaande systemen om bugs op te lossen. Je oplossing breng je via de kwaliteitschecks en pipelines in GitLab weer live. Je werkt met issues in ClickUp en zet AI\-tooling als Cursor en Claude Code in om sneller te bouwen. Zo leer je simplifying digital complexity van binnenuit kennen.


‍
Daarnaast doe je het periodieke onderhoud dat software gezond houdt, zoals framework\-upgrades en het verversen van sleutels en certificaten. De zwaarste incidenten pakt altijd een senior op, en daar groei jij stap voor stap naartoe. Dit is een startplek met veel perspectief, want nergens leer je zoveel verschillende stacks en klanten kennen als hier. Vanaf medior niveau kun je doorgroeien naar onze bouwteams, van maatwerk tot AI\-first en no\-code. Wil je liever verder groeien binnen beheer, dan kan dat net zo goed. Samen met het team ga jij er elke dag vol voor, want onze klanten willen voorop lopen met tech en wij zorgen dat ze die voorsprong ook echt pakken.


‍
### **Het fundament**


Als developer beheer en onderhoud zorg jij dat we waarmaken wat we klanten beloven. Je werk bestaat grofweg uit drie onderdelen.


###### **Oplossen**


Je pakt meldingen op, zoekt uit hoe bestaande systemen in elkaar zitten, lost bugs op en releaset via de kwaliteitschecks. Met elke melding leer je weer een systeem beter kennen.


‍
###### **Onderhouden**


Met upgrades, nieuwe sleutels en certificaten en een vast onderhoudsritme houd jij de software gezond. Voorkomen is beter dan genezen, en dat maak jij elke dag waar.


‍
###### **Leren en groeien**


Je bouwt in hoog tempo brede kennis op van stacks, systemen en klanten. Vanaf medior niveau ligt de route naar de bouwteams open, en wil je je verder verdiepen in beheer, dan kan dat ook.


* 
Dit is wat wij jou kunnen bieden
* Salaris tussen € 2\.500 en € 3\.250 bruto per maand, op basis van 40 uur
* Een groeibudget van € 750 per jaar, zodat je blijft leren en groeien

* Teamuitjes waar we nog lang over napraten
**Onze Smart Grow Formule**

Wat jij ons kan bieden

* 0 tot 3 jaar werkervaring, dit is echt dé startplek en junioren zijn hier van harte welkom
* Een basis in programmeren, bijvoorbeeld in Javascript of PHP, en de drive om breed te leren

jobs.title: Data Engineer (API’s & integraties)
jobs.description:
**Utrecht \| hybride \| 32 tot 40 uur \| €4\.000 tot €5\.500 bruto per maand**  

  



Word jij enthousiast van een complexe API waar je data vandaan moet toveren? Is partitioning je middle\-name en kun jij semantic layer modelling uitleggen aan je neefje? Dan zijn wij misschien wel op zoek naar jou!


**Over Insight First**
----------------------


Insight First is het **remote data \& AI\-team** voor innovatieve en snelgroeiende merken als Pink Gellac, Cloudpillo, Buienalarm en Alpine. Ons doel is om zoveel mogelijk start\- en scale\-ups binnen e\-commerce dagelijks ál hun beslissingen te laten maken op basis van data. We investeren veel in nieuwe tools en (open source) technologie en maken tijd voor leren, automatiseren en experimenteren.


We zijn een ambitieuze club met veel passie voor data, BI en AI maar daarnaast ook voor het maken van de vertaalslag naar de business. Projecten en klanten verdelen we onderling en iedereen heeft binnen zijn of haar expertise ook interne projecten die het verschil maken. Je leert van elkaar, klanten, tools, training maar ook zeker de diversiteit aan projecten en datasets. Geen dag is hetzelfde. Houd jij van deze dynamiek? Lees dan snel verder.


**Wat je doet**
---------------


* Schaalbare en betrouwbare pipelines bouwen zodat de data elke ochtend keurig binnenkomt
* Werken met 50\+ verschillende systemen, API’s en soms ook knutselen als een API niet voorhanden is
* Samenwerken met een team van ervaren data\- en analytics engineers
* Elke dag werken met de nieuwste technologie, open source tooling \& AI
* Werken aan een divers scala aan projecten, van het bouwen van schaalbare connectors tot maatwerk oplossingen
* De ‘go\-to’ persoon zijn in ons team die bij allerhande engineering\-vragen helpt en inspringt

**Deze rol is misschien iets voor jou als:**
--------------------------------------------


* Je minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring als Data Engineer hebt
* Je programmeerervaring hebt met talen zoals SQL, Python of andere
* Je hebt API\-koppelingen gebouwd die in productie draaiden
* Je bekend bent met cloudconcepten en \-platformen (Wij werken met GCP)
* Je nieuwsgierig bent, pro\-actief en graag veel ownership hebt in je werk
* Je houdt van actie. Vandaag bedenken, morgen bouwen, overmorgen bij de klant is geen uitzondering

jobs.description:
At HEMA, we are building an efficient and future\-proof retail technology landscape. To achieve this, we are establishing a new Engineering Organization. This is your chance to help lay the technological foundation for the most iconic, nearly 100\-year\-old department store in the Netherlands. Do you want to make a direct impact on HEMA’s digital progress? Then this role is for you! **the challenge**  

  

  

As a Fullstack/Frontend Engineer in our growing composable front\-end team, you’ll be working on the new HEMA website, built in a modern storefront using Next.js. Here, you work side by side with HEMA developers and developers from our partners. Additionally, you have close contact with Product Owners, Business Owners, IT Analysts, and colleagues from the domain teams. However, your role goes beyond just programming; you help HEMA grow as a tech organization and enable the strategic road map. You collaborate with colleagues from other domains to deliver seamless connected solutions. You will work on challenging projects as well as contribute to building the future\-proof website of HEMA. Think of a MACH architecture, a new CMS to implement (Sanity), continuously improve the use of our commerce tool and improve our infrastructure for internal search. We use modern technologies such as Apache Kafka and KONG as an API management platform. AWS serverless components, Next,js. React and Typescript are currently our weapons of choice. Expertise in a Service\-oriented, API first, and headless tech\-stack is the norm. Innovation is our lifeline; we are always searching for the most efficient solution to support our business teams in serving our customers.
**what we offer**  

  

  

At HEMA, you’ll learn the trade in an environment where people truly work together. You’ll receive proper guidance, useful feedback, and gain valuable experience. At HEMA, over 17,000 colleagues work together to create a better everyday life in a more beautiful world. With products that are more practical, more beautiful, better—and that last longer too. jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description:
**Recent graduates are encouraged to apply.** We are open to candidates with limited professional experience who have a degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or a related field and are motivated to develop into a customer\-facing Application Engineer. Full product and industry training will be provided.  

  

**Application Engineer**

*Amersfoort \| Hybrid*

**Imagine this:**


A production plant is running 24/7\. Its control systems are connected, its processes automated — and every minute of uptime counts. You’re not just the architect of the system; you’re the reason it keeps running. Your design prevents downtime. Your decisions, quietly made, make all the difference.


As an **Application Engineer** at **Yokogawa**, you’ll build and maintain the systems that is the digital foundation of some of the world’s most essential industries — ensuring that safety, stability, and sustainability go hand in hand.


You’ll be part of the **Solution Engineering Team** within the **Operations NL Team** — a diverse group of specialists with complementary skillsets and a shared mindset.


You will be the responsible person for installing and maintaining our **SCADA** system **CI\-SERVER.**

**data historian** and the products that rely on this data historian. You will also be the responsible person for our **custom made applications**.


As Application Engineer you will not only support above mentioned solutions you will also be trained to maintain our **data historian and custom made applications**.


Once you gather enough knowledge you will join our **24/7 standby** team to support our clients 24/7\. In practical this means that you are on duty for 1 week every 4 to 5 weeks. During this period, you can be called to support.

**What You’ll Be Doing**


As an **Application Engineer**, you’ll:

* Install and maintain our CI Server systems.
* Maintain and support our data historian and custom made applications, based on **VB, C\# or the like**.
* Implement modifications to customers systems in a **live environment**.
* Maintain the customer systems to be **reliable and ready 24/7**. This also includes handling assigned emergency calls.
* **Coordinate** and verify work prepared by our **engineering centres** in Romania and India
* Support your customer with **technical questions** or upgrades.
* Creating and maintaining **as\-built documentation** that ensures clarity and continuity.

**What You’ll Need to Succeed**


You’re someone who thrives at the intersection of **technology and responsibility**. You understand the demands of industrial environments and bring a reliable\-by\-design mindset to everything you do.

**You bring:**

* An **MBO / HBO** degree in process automation/control, mechatronics or equivalent
* A **communicative personality** enjoys working in a team of technical experts
* A willingness to **travel** within the **Netherlands frequently** and from to time to time **abroad**
* (Basic) **programming skills**, like JAVA, VB or C\#
* **self\-motivated** in solving problems and searching for new knowledge
* A structured, hands\-on approach to problem solving.
* Strong communication skills in either **Dutch or English**.
* A willingness to deliver **24/7 support** on rotating baes.
* A solution\-focused, flexible attitude and **customer\-centric** mindset.

**What You’ll Get in Return**


We believe in trust, development, and work that matters — and we make sure our people feel that too.


At Yokogawa, you’ll enjoy:

* **31 days off** (25 vacation \+ 6 ADV)
* A **future\-proof pension scheme**
* **8% holiday pay**, paid in May
* **Company lease car** provided once you are qualified for the on\-call rotation
* A **guaranteed 5% annual bonus**
* **Travel allowance** and **home office compensation**
* A **laptop and phone** you can use privately too
* An international **learning \& development program**
* Hybrid working options depending on project phase
* **Collective accident insurance** and peace of mind

**Why Yokogawa?**


Yokogawa has been pioneering industrial automation for over a century. Today, our focus is clear: enable industries to become safer, smarter, and more sustainable.


We’re committed to achieving **net\-zero emissions**, supporting the **circular economy**, and improving well\-being — with a long\-term vision for 2050 and beyond. At Yokogawa, you won’t just build systems. **You’ll build security into the future.**

**Ready to architect security where it truly counts?**  

Apply now and help us protect the processes that keep the world running

**Not just a job, but a career**


Yokogawa, award winner for ‘Best Asset Monitoring Technology’ and ‘Best Digital Twin Technology’ at the HP Awards, is a leading provider of industrial automation, test and measurement, information systems and industrial services in several industries.


Our aim is to shape a better future for our planet through supporting the energy transition, (bio)technology, artificial intelligence, industrial cybersecurity, etc. We are committed to the United Nations sustainable development goals by utilizing our ability to measure and connect.

**About the Team**  

Our 18,000 employees work in over 60 countries with one corporate mission, to "co\-innovate tomorrow". We are looking for dynamic colleagues who share our passion for technology and care for our planet. In return, we offer you great career opportunities to grow yourself in a truly global culture where respect, value creation, collaboration, integrity, and gratitude are highly valued and exhibited in everything we do.

**Diverse, Equitable \& Inclusive culture**


Yokogawa is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Yokogawa wants a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture. We will actively recruit, develop, and promote people from a variety of backgrounds who differ in terms of experience, knowledge, thinking styles, perspective, cultural background, and socioeconomic status. We will not discriminate based on race, skin color, age, sex, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, belief, political opinion, nationality, ethnicity, place of origin, disability, family relations or any other circumstances. Yokogawa values differences and enables everyone to belong, contribute, succeed, and demonstrate their full potential.


Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Yokogawa  

about our Employee Referral process!

jobs.title: Junior Engineer Industriële Informatica
jobs.description:
### **HIGHLIGHTS VAN DEZE VACATURE**


Als MES Software Engineer heb jij directe invloed op de prestaties van complexe productieomgevingen. Of je nu werkt aan de digitalisering van een papierfabriek of het optimaliseren van een farmaceutische proceslijn. Zorg jij straks voor productieprocessen die echt op rolletjes lopen?
### **DIT GA JE DOEN**


Beeld je eens in: een grote internationale producent in de voedingsmiddelenindustrie kampt met verouderde software. Productiestilstand dreigt. Samen met een klein, deskundig team stap jij in. Binnen no\-time ontwikkelen jullie een slim, schaalbaar en stabiel MES\-systeem dat real\-time inzicht geeft in productiegegevens, en direct gekoppeld is aan PLC\- en SCADA\-lagen. Het resultaat: meer grip, hogere efficiëntie en een tevreden klant. Daar doe je het voor.


Als MES Software Engineer werk je aan hoogwaardige informatiesystemen binnen de industriële automatisering. Je werkt aan nieuwbouwprojecten en moderniseert bestaande productieomgevingen. Je krijgt de vrijheid om creatief en zelfstandig oplossingen te ontwerpen, te testen en te implementeren.


Waarom dit uniek is? Omdat je werkt in een organisatie zonder managers, met veel vertrouwen. Jouw kennis en initiatief maken het verschil. En het kantoor? Geen standaard grijs systeemplafond, maar een karakteristiek herenhuis met studentikoze charme waar je je meteen thuis voelt. Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden:

* Je werkt samen met projectteams aan maatwerksoftware voor industriële automatiseringsprojecten;
* Programmeert MES\-systemen voor verschillende productielijnen en installaties;
* Ontwikkelt software, visualisaties en algoritmen om productieprocessen te monitoren en aan te sturen;
* Vertaalt klantwensen naar functionele ontwerpen en technische documentatie;
* En je test en finetunet je eigen software en implementeert deze enkele keren per jaar op locatie bij de klant.


### **DIT BRENG JE MEE**

* Een hbo\- of wo\- diploma in Technische Informatica, Elektrotechniek, ICT, Systems \& Control of vergelijkbaar;
* Ervaring met .NET en C\#;
* Affiniteit met MES\-oplossingen en procesindustrie.


### **HIER KUN JE OP REKENEN**

* Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 3\.300,\- en € 4\.800,\-.
* 23 vakantiedagen
* 8% vakantiegeld.
* Een auto van de zaak die je ook privé mag rijden.
* Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak.
* Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om vanuit huis te werken.
* Uitgebreide mogelijkheden om extra trainingen, cursussen of opleidingen te volgen.
* Een pensioen waar wij 2/3de deel betalen.
* Een contract voor 1 jaar, daarna direct een vast contract.


### **HIER GA JE WERKEN**


Wij zijn een gespecialiseerde System Integrator binnen de industriële automatisering, actief in uiteenlopende sectoren zoals watermanagement, energie, food, pharma, chemie, infrastructuur en datagedreven industrie. Met ruim 80 automatiseringsspecialisten werken we dagelijks aan projecten waarin PLC\-, DCS\- en SCADA\-technologie wordt gecombineerd met high\-end software, OT\-infrastructuur, MES en data\-oplossingen.


We hebben diverse vestigingen, maar werken met zo’n 80 collega’s vlakbij Utrecht, en we groeien gestaag door de stijgende vraag naar slimme automatisering. Wat ons bijzonder maakt? Er is geen sterke hiërarchie en de lijnen zijn kort. Vertrouwen en verantwoordelijkheid staan centraal. Iedereen krijgt hier de ruimte om zijn stempel te drukken op projecten.


Ons hoofdkantoor ligt op een karakteristieke plek vlakbij Utrecht, een oud herenhuis vol sfeer, waar creativiteit en techniek samenkomen. Hier vind je geen strakke maatpakken of hiërarchische vergaderstructuren, maar collega’s met passie voor techniek, die met plezier samenwerken en elkaar vooruit helpen.

jobs.title: Internship: Generative AI Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Job Title**

Internship: Generative AI Engineer
### **Job Description**

**Start date:** November (we are flexible)


**Duration:** at least 3 months (with the option to extend)


**Type:** Internship, Non\-Thesis


**Weekly presence:** 40 hours (32 hours could be an option), at least 3x week on\-site


**Location:** Eindhoven HTC
  

  

**Job title: Internship: Generative AI Engineer**  

We're seeking an intern with hands\-on expertise in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing and Generative AI to join our team. In this role, you will design and build innovative and ethically responsible Generative AI solutions that effectively address real\-world problems, balancing technical feasibility with user needs and business impact. Working at the intersection of natural language processing and machine learning, you will contribute to developing AI solutions that directly impact patient outcomes and Philips' growth in the healthcare sector.  



  

**Your role:**

* Design, train, and evaluate NLP and LLM\-based solutions for various use cases, including retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), information retrieval \& search, chatbots, structured information extraction and named entity recognition, text generation, summarization, and more
* Clean, preprocess, and curate data for evaluation, fine\-tuning, and training
* Work closely with stakeholders across the organization to understand business needs, formulate problems, and deliver data\-driven insights
Keep up the latest advancements in generative AI research and integrate new techniques into the development process  
* 

  

**You're the right fit if:**

* You are studying towards your Bachelor or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
* You have at least **one year of hands\-on experience developing NLP and ML/DL solutions** in an academic or professional environment gained during your studies (e.g. internship project)
* You are proficient in Python and relevant libraries for data science and deep learning (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
* You have a strong **understanding of classic NLP** and **experience with with LLMs** , such as RAG, prompt engineering, data synthesis, automatic evaluation, and fine\-tuning
* You are familiar with cloud computing platforms
* You have excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset are essential
You have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail  
* 

  

**How we work together**  

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week.
  

  

**We offer you** :
  

A non\-stop growth opportunity within Marketing and Communication but also within a global multinational company. In addition, we also want to renumerate you well for the opportunity. This includes:


* Monthly full\-time allowance between €500 \- €700 gross, depending on your education level and if you need to relocate to The Netherlands. Part\-time internships receive the allowance pro\-rata.
* Housing compensation. Should you need to relocate to near our office, we’ll offer you a monthly allowance of €300,\- net if location is in the vicinity of Amsterdam, €255,\- net for all other Philips locations. To be eligible, we’ll just ask for the rental contract from your landlord, and your usual home\-work travel distance needs to be more than 50 km or 1\.5 hours of travel time (for a one way trip).
* Travel compensation, if you are not eligible for a free public transport card; you will receive max. €192,\- net as a monthly allowance.
* Paid holidays per internship term.
The opportunity to buy Philips products at our Philips shop.  
* 

  

**About Philips**  

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
  

* Learn more about our business .
* Discover our rich and exciting history .
* Learn more about our purpose .

  

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our commitment to diversity and inclusion here .

Sta jij stevig in je schoenen en durf je de status quo uit te dagen in jouw streven naar continu verbeteren? Is coachend leiderschap jouw tweede natuur? Wil je een uitdaging met een complex stakeholderveld: hebben we voor je. Wij zoeken een RTE voor de ART BASE. BASE staat voor het fundament waarop bedrijfsprocessen draaien. Denk aan finance, inkoop, logistiek en projectmanagement. Het ERP\-platform vormt de stabiele basis waarop collega's en partners dagelijks kunnen vertrouwen. Maar BASE gaat over meer dan techniek alleen.


* **Foundation** – een solide basis voor bedrijfsvoering.

* **Services mindset** – waarde leveren aan onze stakeholders.
* **Enabler of change** – stabiliteit bieden én tegelijkertijd ruimte creëren voor vernieuwing.

Aan jou de uitdaging om onze agile teams nog succesvoller te maken, te faciliteren dat we waarde gedreven en realistische kwartaalplannen maken en te borgen dat we continu verbeteren. Het energienet van de toekomst maken we voor iedereen, mét iedereen. En als Release Train Engineer werk jij hieraan mee. Zo ben jij bezig met het:

**Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander**

En jij gaat dat doen bij ons bedrijfsonderdeel Alliander.

  

  

Talent herkennen en begeleiden kan alleen als jij genoeg energie hebt. En de juiste werkomgeving geeft jouw dat. Het chapter ATS (Agile Transformatie Specialisten) bestaat uit slimme en betrokken collega’s. Zowel vakinhoudelijk als sociaal is er veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en goede ideeën. **Jij maakt het net energieker**

Werken aan een organisatie die toekomstproof is. Dat doe je vanuit je eigen kracht en talent. En dat doe je bij ons. En vul je dit daarnaast aan met:

* PSM1/SSM/SASM certificering en opleiding in SAFe (SPC / SAFe RTE).

* Bedrevenheid en een pro\-actieve rol als coach binnen je ART. Jij zorgt ervoor dat jouw omgeving zich verder ontwikkelt op individu en als team.

jobs.description:
**Job Description: Test Engineer – Global Service Growth Team (GSGT)**


**Position Summary**  

The Test Engineer on the Global Service Growth Team (GSGT) is responsible for developing, standardizing, and optimizing electrical and functional test methods used within global service operations. This role enables improved throughput, accuracy, and consistency across repair, calibration, and diagnostic processes. The Test Engineer collaborates closely with metrology, manufacturing engineering, quality, and IT to ensure test systems, instrumentation, and automated workflows support world‑class service performance and alignment with FBS practices.

  

**Key Responsibilities**


**Test System Development \& Optimization**


* Design, develop, and refine electrical, functional, and automated test methods for service workflows.
* Evaluate existing test processes for repeatability, accuracy, and cycle time; implement engineered improvements.
* Develop test system specifications, including instrumentation, signal paths, measurement limits, and testing logic.
* Troubleshoot complex electrical or system\-level test issues and implement robust corrective actions.‑level test issues and implement robust corrective actions.


**Instrumentation \& Metrology Integration**


* Ensure test processes adhere to metrology best practices, including traceability, uncertainty considerations, measurement system integrity, and calibration alignment.
* Partner with Metrology teams to harmonize test setups with calibration requirements and ensure measurement confidence across global service sites.
* Support measurement method validation (MMV) and gage R\\\&R studies where applicable.


**Automation \& Digital Test Workflow Support**


* Collaborate with automation and IT engineering to integrate test steps into automated or semi‑automated workflows.
* Optimize automated test sequences through improved logic flow, instrumentation selection, or software changes.
* Support integration of test data into digital systems and dashboards for visibility, troubleshooting, and analysis.


**FBS Coaching \& Lean Execution**


* Coach teams on application of FBS principles to test processes, including standardized work, visual management, root\-cause analysis, and daily management.
* Lead or participate in kaizen events focused on reducing test cycle time, improving repeatability, or eliminating variation.


**Cross\-Functional Technical Collaboration**


* Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineers on fixture design, instrumentation integration, and combined mechanical\-electrical process improvements.
* Work with Quality Engineering on product and process issues, defect reduction, test escapes, and test coverage improvements.
* Serve as a subject\-matter expert on test system readiness during global equipment transfers or new service capability deployments.


**Project \& Site Enablement**


* Support global deployment of standardized test processes, ensuring thorough documentation, training materials, and site readiness.
* Assist with test system procurement, configuration, and commissioning for new service sites or major capability expansions.
* Contribute as an individual contributor on broader service transformation initiatives, aligned with GSGT priorities.

  


**Qualifications**


*(Adjustable to internal HR standards as needed)*


* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Test Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a similar technical field.
* 3\+ years of experience in test engineering, electrical engineering, product support engineering, or a similar environment.
* Strong knowledge of electrical measurement principles, instrumentation, and test system design.
* Familiarity with metrology concepts such as traceability, measurement uncertainty, and calibration processes.
* Experience with automated test systems (ATE), test sequencing software, data acquisition, or LabVIEW/Python/C\# is a plus.
* Understanding of lean manufacturing/FBS practices, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement tools.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex system\-level issues and collaborate across mechanical, software, metrology, and quality teams.

jobs.description:

Seit über 180 Jahren unterstützen wir Unternehmen weltweit dabei, Arbeitsprozesse einfacher, effizienter und zukunftssicher zu gestalten. Mit Niederlassungen in über 40 Ländern und Kunden in mehr als 180 Märkten sind wir ein globaler Partner für Fachwissen und Technologie.


Unsere Lösungen verbinden tiefgehendes Know\-how mit innovativen Technologien – inklusive moderner KI\-Funktionen – und helfen unseren Kunden, ihre größten Herausforderungen erfolgreich zu meistern. Mehr als 21\.000 Kolleginnen und Kollegen weltweit arbeiten, gemeinsam daran, Wissen nutzbar zu machen und Arbeitsprozesse neu zu denken.

  

Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung einer etablierten und geschäftskritischen Business\-Anwendung auf Delphi\-Basis. Neben der nachhaltigen Betreuung und Modernisierung bestehender Funktionalitäten wirkst Du aktiv daran mit, die technische Grundlage für zukünftige Entwicklungen in Richtung moderner Architekturen, APIs, Cloud\-Anbindung und .NET zu schaffen.


Dabei verbindest Du technische Exzellenz mit Pragmatismus und triffst Entscheidungen, die langfristige Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und Wirtschaftlichkeit sicherstellen.

 **Was dich erwartet**

 **Technische Verantwortung und Seniorität**

  

* Übernahme technischer Verantwortung für definierte Anwendungsbereiche und Komponenten
* Strukturierte Analyse komplexer fachlicher und technischer Anforderungen sowie Entwicklung nachhaltiger Lösungskonzepte
* Bewertung und Begründung technischer Entscheidungen unter Berücksichtigung von Qualität, Wartbarkeit, Performance und Wirtschaftlichkeit
* Aktive Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung der Anwendungsarchitektur
* Unterstützung anderer Entwickler bei Analyse, Lösungsfindung und Umsetzung
* Einbringen von Verbesserungsvorschlägen für Entwicklungsprozesse, Qualitätssicherung und technische Standards

 **Eigenständigkeit und** **Ergebnisverantwortung**

  

* Themen proaktiv vorantreiben und nachhaltig zum Abschluss bringen
* Entwicklungsaufgaben eigenverantwortlich von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zur getesteten und dokumentierten Auslieferung umsetzen
* Aufwand realistisch einschätzen, Fortschritt transparent machen und Risiken frühzeitig kommunizieren
* Verantwortung für Qualität, Fehlerbehebung und langfristige Stabilität der eigenen Änderungen übernehmen
* Bei Hindernissen frühzeitig Unterstützung einholen sowie eigene Analysen, Lösungsversuche und konkrete Handlungsvorschläge einbringen
* Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Anwendung und des Entwicklungsvorgehens aktiv fördern

 **Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikation**

  

* Fachliche Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Produktmanagement, Support, Consulting und weiteren Stakeholdern analysieren und in tragfähige technische Lösungen überführen
* Technische Sachverhalte adressatengerecht kommunizieren und nachvollziehbar dokumentieren
* Konstruktive Zusammenarbeit im Entwicklungsteam sowie aktiver Wissensaustausch
* Bereitschaft, Verantwortung über den eigenen Code hinaus zu übernehmen und zur gemeinsamen Produktqualität beizutragen

 **AI\-gestützte Softwareentwicklung**

  

* Bereitschaft, etablierte AI\-Werkzeuge regelmäßig als festen Bestandteil des Entwicklungsalltags einzusetzen und sich kontinuierlich in neue AI\-gestützte Arbeitsweisen einzuarbeiten

* Praktische Erfahrung mit GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugen werden vorausgesetzt

 **Was du mitbringst**

  

* Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Delphi, SQL und objektorientierter Softwareentwicklung
* Erfahrung in der Weiterentwicklung, Wartung und Modernisierung komplexer Business\-Anwendungen und gewachsener Softwaresysteme

* Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
* Pragmatismus bei gleichzeitiger technischer Sorgfalt
* Lernbereitschaft und Offenheit gegenüber neuen Technologien und Arbeitsweisen
* Freude daran, komplexe fachliche Zusammenhänge in nachhaltige Softwarelösungen zu überführen

 **Damit begeistern wir dich**

  



* **Sichere Zukunft**: Du bekommst eine unbefristete Festanstellung in einem internationalen Unternehmen sowie eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit persönlicher Beratung.

* **Karriereentwicklung**: Wir unterstützen Dich mit strukturiertem Onboarding, Learning on the Job, internationalen Karriereoptionen und internen sowie externen Weiterbildungen
* **Gesundheit \& Soziales Engagement**: Unser Corporate Benefits Programm bietet Dir alles von JobRad über Lebens\- und Rentenberatung. Zusätzlich bekommst Du einen zusätzlichen freien Tag, den Volunteer Day, um soziale Projekte zu unterstützen. Mit unserem Programm „Wolters Kluwer hilft“ unterstützen wir als Unternehmen ebenfalls soziale Projekte

* **Teamspirit**: Bei unseren Mitarbeiterevents und über unser Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprogramm erlebst Du echten Zusammenhalt. Kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und Raum für Deine Ideen sind bei uns selbstverständlich

Hanna Fischer

jobs.title: Junior Application Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Junior Application Software Engineer**

**£26\.5k \- £32k**

**Bristol**

**About One Big Circle**

***Be part of an award\-winning workplace: The Sunday Times Best Medium\-sized Technology Company 2025***

Formed in 2017, One Big Circle is a fast\-growing Bristol technology company that provides “Intelligent Video” solutions. We focus entirely on solving real\-world industry problems by fusing new technology in the field of Video, IOT, Cloud and AI providing end to end solutions which allow our customers to dramatically improve their operational efficiency and safety. Our culture is one of high\-quality technical delivery and we work at a speed that many industries are unaccustomed to; we have done this by building a team dynamic that challenges and empowers our people and creating an environment where everyone contributes and learns. We are growing, profitable and have ambitious plans to continue expansion in and beyond our existing markets.

We are looking for a proactive and motivated individual to join our team to support the business.

We have built a culture where people feel supported, included, and empowered to do their best work. Our team is growing, and we’d love for you to be part of the journey.

**Role Summary**

An exciting opportunity to kick\-start your career as a **junior software engineer** in a fast\-growing, office\-based, hands\-on team. This role is ideal if you enjoy being a **broad generalist** \- someone who likes connecting systems, figuring out how different technologies work together, and building practical solutions that make things happen.

You’ll be working across a range of projects and products, helping to integrate services, move data between systems, and turn complex processes into reliable, working software. We don’t expect you to know everything upfront \- what matters most is your curiosity, your willingness to learn by doing, and your interest in understanding how real\-world systems fit together.

**Responsibilities**

* You will help create and test software within a skilled team that likes getting things done.
* You will learn a range of current and new technologies from experienced software and hardware engineers.
* You will be given increasing responsibility for elements of each project as you continue to prove yourself.

There is flexibility in shaping the role around your strengths and interests, but some of the key technical areas you might encounter are listed below:

**You’ll gain experience of a range of full\-stack relevant technologies such as:**

* Python, C\#
* Video Streaming
* Complex data\-platform architecture, multi\-tenant, partitioned, and access\-controlled environments supporting secure and scalable data access
* Docker \& Microservices
* Modern Web Applications built in React.js, and TypeScript

**Personal Qualities and Experience**

You are someone who enjoys learning new skills, finding out things and also learning from mistakes. We’d like you to be reliable, curious, and ready to deal with problems and get them solved. We strongly encourage those from under\-represented groups to be confident in applying to us.

**You do not need to have any formal experience working in software**, but you should be able to demonstrate your interest by having done something or worked on a ‘passion project’ yourself. You might have built a full\-stack web app, made something interesting using AWS services, built and optimized CICD deployment pipelines, or some other relevant activity. You should have some familiarity with at least one general purpose programming language.

You will also be keen to contribute ideas to both the business and the social side of the company.

**Company Benefits Include:**

* Auto enrolment Pension Scheme
* 25 Days Holiday plus bank holidays
* Life Assurance
* Private Healthcare Cover
* Work related training courses as required
* Complimentary snacks and refreshments including fresh fruit
* **Office\-Centric role**
* Access to Bike to Work Scheme
* Secure bike storage and shower facilities
* Social events

**How to Apply**

Join an award\-winning team, named ‘*The Sunday Times Best Medium\-sized Technology Company 2025’*. At One Big Circle, you’ll be part of a fast\-growing team where your ideas and contributions are truly valued.

Please send your CV and covering letter to **jobs@onebigcircle.co.uk**

Please visit our careers page at **onebigcircle.co.uk/careers** to view our full list of current vacancies, including similar roles that may be of interest.

By applying for this role, you understand that we will process your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy, accessible at https://onebigcircle.co.uk/privacy\-policy/

Successful applicants will be required to pass a BPSS (Baseline Personnel Security Standard) check.

Find out more about us at **www.onebigcircle.co.uk**

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: £26,500\.00\-£32,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Product Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced embedded engineer ready to take ownership of firmware platforms that keep critical water infrastructure connected and intelligent? Then join us in our mission to pioneer smarter solutions for moving and transforming water, reducing energy consumption, and enhancing quality of life for people.

  

As our new Senior Product Development Engineer, you will be developing firmware and software on bespoke RTOS and Linux\-based hardware platforms, architecting solutions that connect sensors and telemetry units to cloud technologies for the water utility industry. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well\-being, and a sense of belonging.

 **What you will be doing:**

  

As a key part of the Devices Development team, you'll create impact by Delivering reliable, secure embedded solutions that enable water utilities to monitor and manage critical infrastructure through real\-time data collection and connectivity.

  

Your main responsibilities include:

  

* Architect, develop, and maintain firmware codebases on RTOS and Linux platforms, ensuring reliable data collection from sensors and telemetry units to cloud/server systems
* Drive automated testing methodologies and CI pipelines to improve release quality and reduce manual verification effort
* Mentor less experienced engineers, conduct code reviews, and raise awareness of best practices including cyber security
* Break down high\-level requirements into measurable tasks and lead development activities from New Product Introduction through to quality\-assured releases
* Resolve escalated customer issues across the full system stack — sensor, telemetry, communications, and software — and contribute to customer documentation and training

 **What makes you a great fit**

  

Above all, you are a hands\-on embedded engineer with deep C/C\+\+ expertise, strong ownership mentality, and the ability to lead technical initiatives while mentoring others in a collaborative team environment. We would also imagine that you have:

  

* Degree, HNC, or HND in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline with 5\+ years of C/C\+\+ embedded development experience
* Detailed knowledge of embedded systems, RTOS, TCP/IP networking, and serial communications (e.g. RS\-485\)
* Working knowledge of electronics and systems integration including microcontrollers, ADCs, power supplies, and transceivers
* Understanding of cyber security principles for embedded platforms and experience with continuous integration and build systems

  

It is a plus if you also have:

  

* Experience with Linux\-based embedded development and/or desktop application development (e.g. C\# WPF) or cloud computing
* Knowledge of industrial PLCs and protocols such as Modbus or DF1
* Experience using agile methodologies and ticketing systems such as Jira
**Why you will love working here**

  

We care! Day to day, you can look forward to:

  

* A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.
* Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well\-being activities.
* Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering in your community.
* Access to on\-demand training and learning sessions and carefully structured programmes to pursue personal and professional development opportunities.

  

We are inclusive! Celebrating and valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds.

  

Are you ready to unlock possibilities at Grundfos? Apply today!

  

To get to know us better, follow us on LinkedIn or visit grundfos.com

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Backend Developer who enjoys solving complex problems and building systems that scale. You’ll be part of a tight\-knit, cross\-functional squad that owns its products from idea to production.
  
You’ll have the freedom to lead and make technical decisions, the space to experiment, and the support to keep developing your skills. We’ll encourage you to grow into a T\-shaped developer, with opportunities to get involved in architecture, DevOps and other areas of development.
  
We work together in our Liverpool HQ three days a week because we value collaboration, fast feedback and a strong team culture.
  
  

**Role:** Senior Backend Developer
  
**Location:** Liverpool City Centre HQ / Hybrid (3 days in office) \*\*
  
**Salary:** £65,000–£75,000 depending on experience\*\*
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

* Build and maintain scalable backend services using .NET 8\.0 and Azure
* Write clean, testable and performant code that’s built to last
* Design and implement APIs and database solutions
* Deploy and run services using Docker and Azure Cloud
* Work closely with product owners and designers to bring features to life
* Mentor other developers and help raise the standard across the team
* Share ideas and contribute to how we build and improve our systems


**Our Tech Stack:**  

**Backend:** C\#, .NET 8\.0, Mediator, MassTransit
  
**Database:** SQL Server, Entity Framework, Redis, Mongo
  
**Infrastructure:** Docker, Azure, K8s, RabbitMQ
  
**Monitoring:** Grafana, Loki Stack
  
**Tooling:** Git, CI/CD pipelines, Unit and Integration Testing, Agile methodologies
  
It’s a bonus if you’re familiar with Clean Architecture or the Mediator pattern, but curiosity and a willingness to learn are just as valuable.
  
  

**Engineering Practices:**  

We care deeply about quality and maintainability.
  
* We use CI/CD pipelines for fast and reliable deployments
* Automated testing and peer reviews are part of our daily rhythm
* Our systems are monitored with Grafana and Loki, giving full visibility across environments
* We encourage experimentation, retrospectives and continuous improvement in everything we build


**What We’re Looking For:**  

* Solid experience with C\#, .NET and Dockerised microservices
* Strong understanding of SQL Server and Entity Framework
* Understanding of event driven architecture and modern microservice patterns
* Experience with testing, CI/CD and cloud deployments
* A team player who enjoys mentoring and collaborating
* A pragmatic problem solver who writes clean, maintainable code
* A genuine desire to learn and help others grow


**Why Join Us:**  

* Modern tech stack and a strong culture of engineering excellence
* A collaborative squad where your ideas make a real impact
* Clear path into technical leadership or architecture
* Freedom to innovate and take ownership
* Top\-tier tools and a workspace built for creativity and collaboration


Team and Culture
  
You’ll be joining a collaborative squad of engineers, designers and product thinkers who enjoy building great software together.
  
We believe in ownership, curiosity and craftsmanship. Everyone has a voice, and we trust each other to make good decisions. We support one another, share knowledge and celebrate success as a team.
  
We’re passionate about technology, but even more passionate about building a team that trusts, respects and learns from each other.
  
  

Grow with Acorn
  
  

At Acorn Insurance, we’re proud of our Liverpool roots — and even prouder of how far we’ve come. As part of the Acorn Group, we bring over 40 years of specialist insurance expertise to the table. From humble beginnings, we’ve grown into a national leader, now employing 1,700\+ people across the UK and reached a milestone £750 million in total value of insurance policies written in 2024\.
  
  

We’re growing fast, with new opportunities emerging every week. That growth is largely due to the values we share:
  
  

* We run through walls for our customers and each other
* We challenge the status quo
* We succeed when we help those around us succeed
* We decide quickly when the smart thing to do is use our judgement


**Benefits:**  

* A maximum of 35 days’ holiday (depending on role and tenure) including bank holidays, with additional buy/sell options
* 24/7 mental health support \& free counselling available
* Grow with us: Through career fairs, leadership programs, and learning on the go!
* Flexible benefits, including early access to salary via our internal platform
* Hybrid working options to support work\-life balance and individual needs
* Recognition awards, social events \& more


**Our Commitment to our colleague’s:**  

These aren’t just words — they’re the principles we live by. And we’re proud to back them up with real action, earning recognition and accreditation from leading organisations that share our commitment to people and growth:
  
  

* Mindful Employer – championing mental health and wellbeing
* Disability Confident Level 1 \& 2 – creating accessible, inclusive opportunities
* Menopause Friendly accredited – supporting every stage of life
* ️ Armed Forces Covenant signatory – honouring those who serve
* ️ Armed Forces Defence employer recognition scheme \- Supporting those who serve
* Great Places to Work 2024/25 – fostering an engaging and positive workplace culture
* Best Place to Work for Development – proud to be investing in people’s future
* ‍• Best Place to Work for Women – breaking down barriers to women's career progression


If you’re looking for a company with a strong culture, real career progression, and a people\-first approach — all rooted in the heart of Liverpool — Grow with Acorn.
  
  

A Few Things to Know Before You Apply
  
  

We’re really excited that you’re considering joining Acorn! To help everything go smoothly, here are a couple of things to keep in mind:
  
  

If your application is successful, we will commence relevant employment checks prior to you commencing employment with us. These will include a standard criminal record check and an insolvency register check.
  
  

* Visa Requirements


Because our training is quite comprehensive, we can only consider applicants who have at least one year remaining on their Graduate or Post\-Study Work visa. At the moment, we’re not able to offer visa sponsorship.
  
  

* We’re Here to Support You


We’re committed to creating an inclusive, supportive workplace where everyone can flourish. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process—or once you’re part of the team—just let us know. Whether it’s flexible hours, adapted equipment, or a bit of extra support, we’ll work with you to make sure you can do your best work.

jobs.title: Software Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
**Description**  



  

**Position Overview:**

  

The Software Solutions Consultant is a strategic software advisor dedicated to helping Mid\-Market and strategic SMB customers achieve meaningful business outcomes through the effective adoption, optimization, and lifecycle management of modern software solutions.


Focused on commercial and healthcare accounts within an assigned region, the Licensing Advisor partners closely with Account Managers and cross\-functional solution teams to land, adopt, expand, and renew key software platforms—driving customer success, reduced complexity, and accelerating growth across our software, services, and recurring cloud portfolio.

  

The Software Solutions Consultant combines strong licensing expertise with a forward\-looking solutions mindset, guiding customers through product choices, optimization opportunities, roadmap alignment, and contract strategy. By understanding the customer’s environment, technology priorities, and desired outcomes, the Licensing Advisor shapes the software strategy that supports business transformation—while ensuring customers receive continuous value throughout their lifecycle.

  

This role is critical in delivering a trusted advisor experience, bridging licensing fundamentals with modern solution adoption, and positioning customers for long\-term success across Microsoft, AWS, Adobe, Google, and other strategic software publishers.

 **What you will do as the Software Solutions Consultant:**

 *The requirements below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. This job description is not intended to be a comprehensive list of the duties and responsibilities of the position, and the duties and responsibilities may change without notice.*

 **Customer Success \& Outcome Alignment**

* Engage customers early to define strategic business outcomes and build a tailored Software Success Plan aligning licensing, cloud adoption, roadmaps, and modernization initiatives.
* Drive customers through the LAER framework (Land, Adopt, Expand, Renew) to ensure continuous value realization and support account growth strategies.
* Conduct proactive touchpoints according to each customers needs to evaluate health, usage, optimization opportunities, and potential risks across software and cloud subscriptions.
* Facilitate business reviews and workshops as needed to ensure customers stay on track with adoption plans, renewal milestones, and strategic objectives.

**Software Solutions \& Licensing Strategy**

* Serve as a subject matter expert in software licensing, subscription models, cloud entitlements, and publisher programs across Microsoft, Adobe, AWS, Google, and other SAM focus vendors.
* Evaluate customer environments, product usage, and contract structures to provide clear options for optimization, cost control, and modernization.
* Provide solution\-oriented guidance that bridges licensing with the broader technology ecosystem (cloud, security, workplace, data platforms, managed services).
* Support customers through software lifecycle events including onboarding, rightsizing, renewals, migrations, and product transitions.

**Renewal \& Agreement Management**

* Proactively manage assigned renewals, initiating engagement 90\+ days before expiration to align options with customer goals.
* Partner with AMs to position value\-driven renewal paths, identify upsell/cross\-sell opportunities, and mitigate risks in advance.
* Maintain deep understanding of publisher program updates, product terms, and compliance requirements to help customers stay informed and make confident decisions.


**Sales Partnership \& Opportunity Development**

* Work collaboratively with regional Account Managers as the go\-to resource for software and cloud advisory, helping qualify, design, and close opportunities.
* Identify and advance opportunities for assessments, cloud migration services, modernization initiatives, managed services adoption, and strategic vendor programs.
* Cosell with AMs and Field Sellers to accelerate net\-new customer acquisitions and expansion within existing accounts.
* Support deal structuring through pricing analysis, licensing design, and optimization recommendations.


**Operational Excellence \& Customer Support**

* Maintain accurate documentation of activities, opportunities, success plans, and customer interactions within internal systems.
* Ensure timely communication with licensees on onboarding, offboarding, product changes, and critical updates.
* Monitor customer install bases and subscription health to maintain satisfaction and reduce risk.
* Work cross\-functionally across operations, legal, finance, and vendor teams to resolve issues and build strong customer experiences.

 **What you will bring to the team:**

 *Required*

* 7\+ years of experience in software licensing, cloud subscription management, IT account management, or a related advisory role.
* Demonstrated success providing customer\-facing support and consultative guidance.
* Solid foundational understanding of IT infrastructure, cloud services, and modern workplace concepts.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and experience resolving complex customer issues.
* Strong understanding of software licensing, cloud subscription models, and key publisher ecosystems (Microsoft, Adobe, AWS, Google).
* Ability to connect licensing strategy with business outcomes, cloud adoption, and modernization initiatives.

**JOB DETAILS**
---------------

JOB BAND: C

Please note: While BBC Studios offers 26 days of annual leave, Studioworks provides 25 days. Other benefits may also vary slightly between the two entities.


**WE ARE BBC STUDIOWORKS**
--------------------------

BBC Studioworks is a commercial subsidiary of BBC Studios providing studios and post production services to all the major TV broadcasters and production companies including the BBC, ITV, Sky, Channel 4, Channel 5, Amazon \& Netflix. Located across sites in Elstree and Television Centre in White City, our London facilities are home to some of the nation’s most watched and loved television shows. We offer world\-class studio and post production spaces, equip them with the right technology and engage the most dedicated and talented people in the industry. By doing this, we bring shows to life.  



  

We have 3 studios at BBC TV Centre one of which is 4K UHD capable. Elstree having 3 dedicated studios for our commercial work and an additional 9 shooting areas and 4 galleries to film the continuing Drama Eastenders. Studioworks also have a studio in Glasgow at Kelvin Hall and also at Digbeth Loc Studios in Birmingham.  



**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**

  

As a Studio Engineer, you will ensure the reliability, performance and readiness of broadcast systems supporting one of the UK's most iconic productions, EastEnders. Working across studios and technical areas, you will maintain, rig, troubleshoot, modify and operate a wide range of broadcast equipment, including cameras, routers, mixers, sound desks and communications systems. The role requires strong technical expertise, flexibility and the ability to deliver under operational and programme pressures.  



  

**WHY JOIN THE TEAM**

  

This is an opportunity to work at the heart of a fast\-paced, high\-profile production environment where no two days are the same. You'll collaborate closely with production teams, anticipate their needs and contribute to the delivery of world\-class television. The role offers exposure to diverse technologies and systems, opportunities to solve complex technical challenges, and the chance to develop your skills while supporting a flagship BBC programme.  



  

**YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT:**

* Maintain, align, modify and troubleshoot broadcast equipment and systems, ensuring all technical facilities meet operational and production requirements.
* Partner with production teams and colleagues to plan technical solutions, provide expert advice, and deliver programme requirements effectively.
* Monitor and maintain technical standards across sound, vision and data signal paths, ensuring faults are resolved quickly with minimal disruption.
* Drive technical innovation by developing, testing and implementing new equipment, systems and workflows to improve operational capability.
* Rig, configure and operate broadcast equipment including recorders, servers, cameras, monitoring facilities and location\-based technical systems.
* Lead or support equipment installations, refurbishments, acceptance testing and complex fault resolution, working with specialist departments, contractors and manufacturers as required.
* Support team development through training, coaching and supervision of junior staff and trainees, while maintaining health and safety compliance, documentation and operational reporting.
**YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**
------------------------------

**ESSENTIAL CRITERIA:**

* Relevant qualifications, training, or demonstrable experience in broadcast engineering within a television studio or live production environment.
* Strong technical knowledge of broadcast systems, including cameras, routers, vision and audio mixers, sound desks, communications systems, talkback infrastructure, computer systems, and networks.
* Experience working with a variety of broadcast technologies and software platforms, with the ability to quickly adapt to new systems and workflows.
* Ability to assess and maintain high technical standards, including the critical evaluation of television pictures, waveforms, audio quality, and signal integrity.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer\-focused approach and the ability to build effective relationships with production and operational teams.
* Proven problem\-solving skills, using sound judgement to identify solutions, prioritise workloads effectively, and determine when to escalate or delegate tasks.
A self\-motivated and collaborative team player who thrives under pressure, demonstrates flexibility in a fast\-paced production environment, and has sufficient colour vision and hearing to carry out the duties of the role.

We appreciate your interest in this position and understand how important this opportunity is to you. Due to the high volume of interest we may need to close the application period earlier than anticipated. Description:
**Job Title:** Senior Software Engineer, Prime Technology


**Corporate Title**: Vice President


**Department:**Information Technology \- Global Markets IT (GMIT)


**Location:** London (Hybrid)

  

**Company overview**

  

Nomura is a financial services group with an integrated global network. By connecting markets East \& West, we service the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through our four business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking) and Banking.

  

Driven by the insights of some 28,000 people worldwide, we put our clients at the center of everything we do, delivering unparalleled access to, from and within Asia. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com  

  

  



**Department Overview:**

  

The Information Technology department at Nomura is at the forefront of innovation, driving technology solutions that empower our business and enhance client experiences. We leverage cutting\-edge technologies to develop and maintain robust systems and infrastructure, ensuring the security, reliability, and efficiency of our operations. Join our team and be part of a dynamic and collaborative environment that embraces technological advancements to deliver value and drive our digital transformation journey.

  

This role sits within Global Markets IT (GMIT), specifically the Equities IT function supporting the Prime business. The team builds and runs platforms underpinning Nomura's global Prime Brokerage offering, spanning both Cash Prime Brokerage (CPB) and Synthetic Prime Brokerage (SPB). Nomura is making significant strategic investment in its Prime Brokerage franchise, with multi\-million dollar technology investment driving the expansion of CPB and SPB capabilities globally. Joining this team means contributing directly to that growth agenda, working on systems that are central to the firm's Prime strategy.

  

**Role Description:**

  

Responsibilities include:

  

* Own end\-to\-end technical delivery of complex platform initiatives, remaining hands\-on with coding and design.
* Set technical direction and engineering standards, mentoring junior and mid\-level engineers across the team.
* Champion a test\-first culture, ensuring automated testing at scale is built into the pipeline, not retrofitted.
* Drive continuous improvement in engineering practices, tooling and delivery methodology across the platform.
* Lead engagement with business analysts, business stakeholders and production support to shape robust solutions.
* Take ownership of production issues and major incidents, actively participating in incident calls when required.
* Proactively identify, escalate and manage technical and delivery risks across the platform.
  

**Skills, experience, qualifications and knowledge required:**

  

* Extensive hands\-on software development experience in Java, with a strong track record of delivering complex systems at scale.
* Deep expertise in automated testing methodologies, including embedding test automation and TDD practices into CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong technical background across database, messaging/queueing, cloud and observability technologies, with the ability to ramp up quickly on specific tools.
* Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership and mentoring engineers, without necessarily holding formal line management responsibility.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, engaging confidently with business analysts, business stakeholders and senior partners.
* Experience taking ownership of production issues and major incidents, including active participation in incident calls.
* Track record of driving continuous improvement in engineering practices, tooling and delivery methodology.
* Experience within financial services or Prime Brokerage is beneficial but not essential.
  

**Nomura Leadership Behaviours**

  

* **Explore Insights \& Vision:** Identify the underlying causes of problems faced by you or your team and define a clear vision and direction for the future.
* **Making Strategic Decisions**: Evaluate all the options for resolving the problems and effectively prioritize actions or recommendations.
* **Inspire Entrepreneurship in People**: Inspire team members through effective communication of ideas and motivate them to actively enhance productivity.
* **Elevate Organizational Capability**: Engage proactively in professional development and enhance team productivity through the promotion of knowledge sharing.
* **Inclusion**: Respect DEI, foster a culture of inclusion and psychological safety in the workplace and cultivate a "Risk Culture" (Challenge, Escalate and Respect).
  

**Right to Work**

  

The UK Government have taken steps to reduce net migration to the UK by limiting the number of overseas workers coming to the UK for employment. Please note that whilst we are able to consider applications from overseas workers from outside the UK (who require a Tier 2 Skilled Worker visa) we can only employ them if we can provide evidence that this is a genuine vacancy for a qualified role.

  

**Diversity \& Inclusion**

  

Nomura is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to ensuring we best reflect the diversity of the communities we serve creating an inclusive environment for all our employees. We welcome all applications and do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender identity and gender expression, pregnancy and maternity, marriage and civil partnership, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.


If you require any assistance or reasonable adjustments due to a disability or long\-term health condition, please do not hesitate to contact us.

  

***Nomura is an Equal Opportunity Employer***
