**Location**
------------


Birmingham, Cardiff, Edinburgh, Exeter, Ipswich, Leeds, Manchester, Newcastle and Nottingham. (Croydon and Stratford will only be available to existing employees of the Insolvency Service).**About the job**
-----------------

### **Job summary**


The Insolvency Service is a leading government agency which plays a crucial role in providing essential services to the public and to business. The work we do is important to the proper functioning of markets, the economy in general and support for thousands of people each year who are in financial difficulty.


We have an exciting opportunity for a talented, enthusiastic Senior DevOps Engineer within our Digital Services team. We are responsible for developing, maintaining and supporting the agencys line of business applications.


Inclusive and diverse teams are important to us. We welcome and encourage applications from everyone, including groups underrepresented in our workforce. The Insolvency Service strives to ensure that the agency is a safe, inclusive, and welcoming place for everybody to bring their true self to work and to help the agency to achieve its diversity objectives. We have 9 active employee network groups available to join or become an ally, these include, Carers Network, Disability network group, Employee Assistance, Representatives, FACES Network Group, LGBT\+, Mind Matters, Part Time Workers, The Shed \- Mens Network Group and Womens Network Group.


We value capability, technical skills and experience and we place great emphasis on lifetime development to support our people. We encourage our employees to become more involved in areas they feel strongly about, whether it be for the benefit of the agency, through our Engagement network or in their own local communities via volunteering opportunities.


The Insolvency Service is a great place to work, learn and grow your career!


If you would like to find out more about the role, the team and what it's like to work at the Insolvency Service, we are holding a Hiring Manager Q\&A session for this role where you can virtually meet the team on 6th October at 10\.00\-11\.00\. Please click here to reserve your place.

### **Job description**


Digital Services has recently transitioned from a third\-party DevOps model to a fully in house capability. We are standardising and consolidating our technology stack as we move away from legacy services, creating a fantastic opportunity for you to help shape our future digital landscape.


Digital Services is part of Change and Technology Services (CTS) who support and improve applications and systems across the agencys IT landscape. CTS provide key services including digital services, cyber security, information governance, service architecture and technical governance.


Our DevOps team looks after the deployment and maintenance of our Digital Services in line with the Governments Digital Service Standard and Technology Code of Practice. They work closely with delivery teams to ensure the products are secure and meet the demands of its users.

**Responsibilities**


As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will:

* provide subject matter expertise and guidance on Microsoft Azure
* build and maintain Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD tooling
* improve deployment pipelines, monitoring and observability across our digital products
* ensure the stability, security and performance of production and non‑production environments
* lead on incident investigation, root cause analysis, and service improvement
* define and maintain DevOps standards, including IaC, observability, deployment patterns, and runbooks
* support delivery teams with DevOps best practice and provide mentoring to junior engineers
* produce clear, accurate documentation aligned to Digital Services standards
* contribute to technical estimates and roadmap planning
* provide coaching and mentoring to more junior colleagues
### **Person specification**


You will need to:

* be an enthusiastic team player, comfortable collaborating with colleagues at all levels.
* stay calm under pressure and manage multiple priorities effectively
* have a keen eye for detail and a tenacious approach to solving problems
* possess strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, diagnose issues and improve repeatable processes
* ideally have experience in software development
* communicate clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing
* build strong relationships across Digital Services to support secure, stable delivery

**Essential Criteria**


To be considered for this role you must:

* possess extensive experience in a similar role using Microsoft Azure
* possess significant CI/CD experience using Azure DevOps(ADO)/Team Foundation Server (TFS)
* have extensive experience creating, maintaining and monitoring both Azure PaaS and IaaS resources
* have demonstrable experience of running multiple applications in multiple environments in a large enterprise
* have experience is writing and maintaining bicep IaC at an expert level
* have an active Security Clearance or be committed to gaining clearance within the first 6 months of joining

**Desirable Criteria**


It would be beneficial if you also have experience of one or more of the following:

* using Terraform to build, manage and maintain infrastructure as code
* working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 environments or integrations
* using PowerShell to automate deployment, configuration, monitoring or operational tasks
* developing or supporting applications using C\#/.NET
* working with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate or related services

**Further Information**


Please note: This vacancy is advertised across 11 locations; however, Stratford and Croydon are only available to current Insolvency Service Staff. The advertised salary includes London weighting, which is only applicable to internal candidates.


If you do not currently hold Security Check (SC) clearance, we will support you through the vetting process following a conditional offer of employment. As SC clearance is essential for this role, appointment is dependent of successfully obtaining and maintaining it. We will provide guidance and support through this process.

### **Behaviours**


We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:


* Managing a Quality Service
* Changing and Improving
### **Technical skills**


We'll assess you against these technical skills during the selection process:


* During the interview, you will be given a hypothetical scenario that will assess your technical knowledge and approach. You are not required to create a presentation.
**Benefits**
------------


Alongside your salary of £48,429, Insolvency Service contributes £14,029 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .
We want you to have a good work\-life balance and want to support you in all that you do, so we offer a great benefits package including:


* flexible working arrangements and flexi\-time
* full time new entrants to the Civil Service and those Civil Servants on modernised terms and conditions will be entitled to 25 days leave increasing on a sliding scale to 30 days after 5 years service
* in addition to this you are entitled to 8 public/bank holidays plus an additional day of privilege leave
* competitive maternity, paternity and parental leave
* 5 days paid leave for learning and development
* 5 days paid for volunteering
* a Cycle to work scheme
* staff have access to an employee assistance programme, Workplace Wellness, for confidential, independent support and advice during difficult times in either their professional or personal life


Your pension is a valuable part of your total reward package where the employer makes a significant contribution to the cost of your pension. Your contributions come out of your salary before any tax is taken. This means, if you pay tax, your take\-home pay will not be reduced by the full amount of your contribution; and your pension will continue to provide valuable benefits for you and your family if you are too ill to continue to work or die before you retire. For more information, visit www.civilservicepensionscheme.org.uk

---------------------------

### **Artificial intelligence**


Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.### **Selection process details**

* **Multi\-Stage Screening Process**


As part of the application process, candidates will be asked to upload a CV outlining their experience, skills and suitability for the role, and complete a multi\-stage screening process. Candidates who are longlisted will be invited to complete a short, pre\-recorded video screening interview. Alternatively, written responses may be provided in place of the video interview. Our recruitment partner (Inspire People) will assess applications against the essential criteria to produce a shortlist, which will then be reviewed by Insolvency Service hiring managers. Successful candidates will be invited to interview.

* **Behavioural Competencies** \- assessed through:
  

	+ Behaviour 1  Managing a Quality Service
	+ Behaviour 2  Changing and Improving
* **Technical Skills**

**Expected timeline (subject to change)**


Sift  TBC


Interview  TBC


Location \- MS Teams


Your interview will either be conducted face to face or by video. You will be notified of this if you are selected for interview. Candidates are asked to note the above timetable, exercising flexibility through the recruitment and selection process.

To sponsor a candidate under the Skilled Worker visa, a sponsorship licence is required. The Insolvency Service does not currently hold this licence and therefore, cannot legally sponsor Skilled Worker visa applicants.

**Queries and Support**


When contacting us or the Government Recruitment Service (GRS) using the contact details at the bottom of this advert, please include the 6\-digit Vacancy ID, job title, your full name and, where applicable, your 8\-digit Applicant ID in the email subject line. This will help us process your enquiry more efficiently.

  

Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview or assessment.### **Security**


Successful candidates must undergo a standard (or equivalent) criminal record check.
Successful candidates must meet the security requirements before they can be appointed. The level of security needed is security check .  

  

See our vetting charter .
People working with government assets must complete baseline personnel security standard (opens in new window) checks.### **Nationality requirements**


This job is broadly open to the following groups:


* UK nationals
* nationals of the Republic of Ireland
* nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
* nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre\-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)

* Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements
### **Working for the Civil Service**


The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.  

  

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles .
The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria.### **Diversity and Inclusion**


The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy .**Apply and further information**
---------------------------------

Once this job has closed, the job advert will no longer be available. You may want to save a copy for your records.### **Contact point for applicants**

* Name : CTS Business Management
* Email : ctsbusinessmanagement@insolvency.gov.uk

### **Further information**


A candidate can raise a complaint to the Insolvency Service by emailing the contact point for applicants (as listed on the vacancy advert), if they think that: They have been discriminated against under the Equality Act 2010 there have been procedural irregularities at any stage of the recruitment process All complaints must be received by the contact point for applicants within 24 hours from the date the applicant is advised of their non\-success at sift, assessment or interview. Complaints will be considered by an independent third\-party outside of recruitment campaign. The decision will be conveyed to the applicant, in writing, within 5 working days of receipt of the complaint. The recruitment process will usually be put on hold until the complaint has been resolved. Complaints may also be made to the Civil Service Commission at any time if the individual believes their application has not been treated in accordance with the recruitment principles (appointment on merit through fair and open competition). However, complaints must first have been raised to the Insolvency Service

Job Description



Job Title: Project Engineer \- Automation
Posting Start Date: 25/09/2026
Job Id: 3188
School/Department: Advanced Manufacturing Research Centre
Work Arrangement: Full Time (Hybrid)
Contract Type: Permanent
Salary per annum (£): 32080
Closing Date: 16/10/2026
The University of Sheffield is a remarkable place to work. Our people are at the heart of everything we do. Their diverse backgrounds, abilities and beliefs make Sheffield a world\-class university.

  

We offer a fantastic range of benefits including a highly competitive annual leave entitlement (with the ability to purchase more), a generous pensions scheme, flexible working opportunities, a commitment to your development and wellbeing, a wide range of retail discounts, and much more.

  

As a Project Engineer for Automation, you will be based in the area of Automation and Battery Manufacturing within the AMRC North West facility, this will cover a range of automated assembly and robotics applications across sectors such as aerospace, automotive, small/medium enterprise support and high\-voltage battery pack assembly. We hope you will instigate a hands\-on approach when involved with the design and physical integration of robotic equipment.  

Involvement in the AMRC North West project is a fantastic opportunity to influence the way products are being manufactured and to develop innovative solutions to industrial problems in the UK. You will deal directly with some of the most advanced technologies and companies in the world.  

We would need you to have previous experience of working in a practical environment and a good degree in a relevant subject (or equivalent experience). You should also have excellent leadership skills and the ability to successfully coordinate project resources. It is key that you can work well within a project team made up of internal colleagues and external customers.  

**Main duties and responsibilities**  

* System design and physical integration / installation of robotic equipment within bespoke cells to improve the efficiency and performance of machines.
* Provide guidance, assistance and technical advice with programming and integration of associated software and hardware systems.
* Assist with the delivery of research projects ensuring that they meet customer costs, requirements and manufacturing feasibility.
* Co\-ordinate and liaise with industrial collaborators and suppliers.
* Report project deliverables, both written and verbally.
* Ensure all processes comply with the AMRCs quality standards.
* Supply support for other members of staff as appropriate and required.
* Research novel technology and its application into industry by researching into problem areas to advance basic knowledge and evaluate new techniques to solve those problems.
* Project management including managing resources, tracking actions/deliverables and liaising with project partners and suppliers.
* Sourcing and purchasing project equipment.
* Providing temporary assistance for other projects when required, to ensure they are completed successfully and on time.
* Carry out other duties, commensurate with the grade and remit of the post

**Person Specification**  

Our diverse community of staff and students recognises the unique abilities, backgrounds, and beliefs of all. We foster a culture where everyone feels they belong and is respected. Even if your past experience doesn't match perfectly with this role's criteria, your contribution is valuable, and we encourage you to apply. Please ensure that you reference the application criteria in the application statement when you apply.  

Essential criteria  

* Have a good honours degree in a relevant subject (or equivalent experience). (assessed at: application)
* A good grasp of engineering and/or scientific principles and the ability to make decisions on the use of complex technology (assessed at: application \& interview)
* Experience and knowledge working with programming robotic arm manipulators (assessed at: application \& interview)
* Experience and knowledge working with CAD software (assessed at: application \& interview)
* Experience in performing experimental work (assessed at: interview)
* Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, to present to customers and communicate to staff on all levels within the organisation (assessed at: interview)
* Ability to assess and coordinate resources, plan and progress personal work activities, with the support and mentorship of your line manager (assessed at: interview)
* Ability to work as a “self\-starter”, capable of tackling new challenges and stretching oneself professionally (assessed at: interview)
* Ability to develop creative approaches to problem solving (assessed at: interview)
* Experience of monitoring project progression and regular customer communication through either teleconferencing or face to face, for example verbal presentation. (assessed at: application \& interview)

Desirable criteria  

* Knowledge of computer programming with experience in a scientific program language e.g., Python, Java, C\+\+, C, C\#, LabVIEW, MATLAB, Halcon, R, Maple, Visual Basic or similar (assessed at: application)
* Experience in using automation simulation packages such as discrete event simulation and robotic simulation (assessed at: application)

**Further Information**
**Grade:** 6

jobs.title: Heating System Design Engineer (Field)
jobs.description:
##### **Upgrade Your Career With Aira**


Clean\-energy tech leads to a positive global transformation. Heating homes contribute to 15% of Europe's CO2 emissions. Switching to sustainable solutions offers households a way to achieve net\-zero emissions.


Aira's mission is to advance the next generation of home energy solutions, creating intelligent, sustainable homes for a meaningful impact. Starting with innovative heat pumps, it will evolve into a comprehensive, intelligent clean energy\-tech system and include dynamic electrical tariffs, cutting\-edge home solar systems, and advanced battery storage solutions.

##### **About the role as Heating System Design Engineer at Aira**


The survey/design visit is a key aspect of the customer journey to ensure an installation goes ahead as planned, and as the customer expects. You will find solutions to problems, ensure the project works in the interests of both the customer and Aira, and provide excellent customer service along the way. You will have the technical expertise to offer additional products and services we may offer in the interests of the customer.

##### **What you’ll be doing as Heating System Design Engineer at Aira**

* Have the necessary qualifications, training, and experience to design high quality air source heat pump installations for domestic properties.
* Gather information from the quote, property and your survey data to generate an accurate heat loss calculation and emitter output requirements
* Find solutions to any technical issues where possible to ensure an installation can still go ahead
* Report any issues which may affect installation to your line manager from the customers property.
* Keep up to date with all manufacturer's guidance, and any legislative changes including but not limited to heat pumps, low carbon heating, clean energy, and building regulations.
* Operate within required Aira’s efficiency guidelines as well as MCS etc.

##### **What might a day look like?**

* Attend customer properties in your designated area
* Conduct a site survey and collect data relevant to the installation requirements
* Carry out a room by room heat loss assessment
* Determine which radiators need to be replaced, and communicate this with your customer
* Answer any technical queries the customer may have
* Communicate any price changes with the customer and explain the reason for these
* Obtain approval from the customer for your proposal to go ahead
* Create a list of materials required for the installation to be carried out

##### **What you'll need to have as Heating System Design Engineer at Aira**

* You'll need to have the necessary qualifications, training, and experience to design high quality air source heat pump installations for domestic properties.


The following would be useful to have;

* Qualifications in System design such as Heat Geek Heating Mastery
* Level 3 Award in installation and maintenance of air source heat pump systems
* Water regulations certificate (WRAS) course
* Level 2 / 3 Award in plumbing
* Level 3 Award Low temperature heating and hot water systems in dwellings

**What is in it for you?**

* **Salary of £42,000**
* 25 days annual leave \+ bank holidays
* Health Cash Plan
* Reward Gateway (shopping discount)
* Life insurance
* 25 days Annual Leave plus Bank Holidays
* iPad, Phone and all equipment provided

*(We encourage early applications as we may close the role once we find the right candidate.)*


At Aira, We’re not just champions of next\-generation energy, we’re champions in Diversity and Inclusion too. We believe that a diverse workforce sparks innovation and creativity and enables us to better serve our customers and communities. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives to join our team. We will never accept any form of discrimination and believe that together, we can drive a new era for our people and planet.

jobs.title: Apprentice Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**Apprentice Technical Support Engineer**

**Location: Truro, with UK\-wide travel and overnight stays during busier seasonal periods**

**Contract: Apprenticeship Contract**

**Salary: £10\.85 per hour**

**Start your engineering career while helping make heating better for everyone**


At Kensa, we’re making heating better \- for people, for the planet and for the future. Since 1999, we’ve been leading the way in ground source heat pump technology, delivering affordable, low\-carbon heating solutions that support the UK’s transition to net zero.


We’re now looking for an Apprentice Technical Support Engineer to join our Technical Support team. This is a practical, varied opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, build valuable engineering skills and begin a career in the growing low\-carbon heating sector.


If you’re curious about how things work, enjoy solving problems and are keen to learn, this could be a great first step. You’ll combine hands\-on experience with a Low Carbon Heating Technician apprenticeship at Cornwall College, attending the Camborne campus one day each week.

**The role**


You’ll join our friendly Technical Support team and learn how to help engineers, installers and customers get the best from ground source heat pump systems. With training and mentoring from experienced colleagues, you’ll build confidence in fault\-finding and diagnostics, provide clear support by phone, and gain practical experience both remotely and on site.


As your skills and experience grow, you’ll have the opportunity to take on more responsibility and explore a future career within Kensa’s technical team.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Support engineers, installers and customers by telephone, listening carefully and communicating clearly and professionally.
* Learn how to diagnose technical faults remotely and help identify practical solutions.
* Assist senior engineers and follow technical guidance, processes and instructions.
* Build knowledge of heat pumps, plumbing, electrical systems and renewable heating technologies.
* Gain experience of zero\-carbon central heating and hot water systems, including installation, commissioning, servicing, maintenance and repair.
* Support site\-based activities when required. The role may involve significant travel during seasonal peaks, potentially across the UK, including overnight stays and time away from home.
* Work collaboratively with colleagues while developing the confidence to complete tasks independently.

**Your apprenticeship**


You’ll complete the Low Carbon Heating Technician apprenticeship with Cornwall College, attending the Camborne campus one day each week. Your off\-the\-job training will take place during your contracted working hours, so you’ll have dedicated time to learn and develop. We’re ideally looking for someone to start the apprenticeship in October.


The programme will help you develop the knowledge and practical skills to work with low\-carbon heating and hot water systems, including ground and air source heat pumps, associated pipework, components, and mechanical and electrical controls.

**What we’re looking for**

* Enthusiasm for engineering, renewable energy or learning how things work.
* A positive attitude and willingness to learn, ask questions and develop new skills.
* Clear communication and the ability to listen carefully and work well with others.
* A thoughtful, customer\-focused approach and an interest in solving problems.
* Reliability, attention to detail and a willingness to take responsibility for your work.
* Willingness and availability to undertake significant travel during seasonal peaks, which may be UK\-wide and involve overnight stays.
* A full UK driving licence would be helpful but is not essential.


You don’t need previous experience with heat pumps or to meet every point above. What matters most is your curiosity, willingness to learn and interest in building a career in low\-carbon heating. If the role appeals to you, we encourage you to apply.

**What we offer**


At Kensa, we’re committed to creating a supportive, rewarding and purpose\-driven place to work. When you join us, you can expect:

* 25 days’ annual leave, increasing to 30 days after five years, plus bank holidays.
* Flexible working arrangements, including hybrid options where possible.
* Career development support, including training and support for recognised qualifications.
* Free 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme for you and your immediate family.
* Private healthcare after one year of service.
* Paid volunteering days to support community impact.
* Electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme.
* Company pension scheme with employer contributions.
* A collaborative culture where your work directly supports the UK’s transition to greener, more affordable heating.

**Ready to apply?**


If you’re excited to learn, develop practical skills and start a career in a growing low\-carbon business, we’d love to hear from you.


We welcome applications from all backgrounds and communities. If you need any adjustments during the application process, please let us know \- we’ll be happy to support you.


You’re welcome to include a short cover note explaining what draws you to Kensa and why this apprenticeship interests you, but it’s optional \- please apply in the way that suits you best.

**Closing Date: Friday 2nd October 2026**

jobs.title: Senior Python Developer
jobs.description:
**Senior Python Developer**

**Salary:** From £50,000 per annum, depending on experience

**Location:** Remote, open to candidates anywhere in the UK. If you like to work alongside colleagues in person, our offices are in Birmingham, Bristol, Exeter and London.

**Term/Hours:** Permanent, 32–40 hours per week. We are flexible on working pattern, so please tell us what suits you in your application.

**Closing date for applications:** Monday 12th October 2026

**We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of sex, gender identity, age, disability, ethnicity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.**

**We are only accepting direct applications (no recruiters please).**

**Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications requiring visa sponsorship now, or in the future.**

**About the Role**


We are looking for a **Senior Python Developer** (or someone operating close to senior level) to join our five\-person energy development team. You will help lead the design and implementation of Python packages building on the Home Energy Model that will enable the next generation of energy performance assessment.


You will work closely with DESNZ, external collaborators, our internal domain experts and your dev team, turning tangible and pressing user needs into reliable, maintainable Python software. The team is supportive and high\-performing, and the work has a direct impact on carbon reduction.


This role includes **line management**. You may already manage one or more developers, or you may be ready to take that step, supported by our programme of leadership and management training. Either way, you will help the people you manage to do their best work and develop their careers.

**What you will do**

* Design, build and improve Python packages for modelling, simulation and data processing.
* Lead engineering decisions, architecture discussions and technical problem solving.
* Turn analytical and modelling needs into shippable software.
* Line manage one or more developers: regular one\-to\-ones, objective setting, performance reviews and support for their development.
* Mentor colleagues across the team and set a strong example through code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing.
* Maintain high code quality through testing, documentation and thorough code reviews.
* Work across disciplines to integrate tools and deliver results for our customers.
* Drive continuous improvement in our tools, processes and engineering standards.
* Own your deliverables and keep projects moving with urgency and accountability.

 **About Us**


City Science is an SME founded in 2015 with one core mission: delivering decarbonisation. We help organisations that are serious about net zero achieve meaningful, quantifiable carbon reductions quickly and efficiently.


We work collaboratively across the business to provide integrated solutions for a wide range of clients, from national bodies such as DESNZ and the Climate Change Committee (CCC) to forward\-thinking local authorities such as Oxfordshire County Council. Our award\-winning research, software and product development team builds innovative digital tools, such as our GIS software, Cadence, that sit at the heart of how we deliver our projects.

 **Essential**

* Strong professional experience as a Python developer, at or near senior level.
* Excellent command of Python and its ecosystem, including libraries, tooling and best practice.
* A track record of building production\-grade applications, ideally in data\-rich or scientific domains.
* The ability to write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code.
* Experience line managing or formally mentoring developers, **or** a clear willingness and motivation to take on line management responsibilities.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to explain technical ideas clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience working in multidisciplinary teams.

**Desirable**

* Experience with Pydantic and/or JSON Schema.
* Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD.
* A strong grasp of geometry and physics, ideally including building physics.
* Understanding of decarbonisation and energy systems.
* Experience supporting the growth of more junior engineers, such as onboarding or coaching.

**Aligned to Our Values**

* **Excellence:** You hold high standards in your code, your solutions and your engineering decisions.
* **Ownership \& Accountability:** You take responsibility for outcomes and proactively drive progress.
* **Data Driven:** You use evidence, analytical thinking and testing to guide your choices.
* **Results Orientated:** You focus on delivering outputs that create real\-world impact.
* **Adaptability \& Learning:** You embrace change, seek out new knowledge and learn quickly.
* **Passion \& Urgency:** You care about what you build and work with purpose.
* **Meritocracy:** You value competence and fairness, and you help raise the bar for everyone around you.
* **Entrepreneurial:** You are resourceful and creative, and you bring ideas that move the business forward.

 **What We Offer**

* **Fully remote working**, with optional access to **our offices in Birmingham, Bristol, Exeter and London** whenever you want them.
* **Flexible working hours** to support a healthy work–life balance.
* A **talented, friendly and supportive team** of engineers, data scientists and domain experts.
* **Impactful projects in decarbonisation and sustainability.**
* Real opportunities to grow, including as a people leader, and to shape exciting new products and capabilities.
* 25 days’ annual leave, plus bank holidays.
* Buy/sell annual leave policy.
* Membership of our group pension scheme.
* Enhanced maternity and paternity policy.
* Eye care policy.
* Cycle to work scheme.
* Employee assistance programme.

 **How to Apply**


Please include:

* Your CV, highlighting relevant experience.
* Examples of projects that show your technical skills.
* Links to relevant code repositories or portfolio work.
* A short note on any line management or mentoring experience, or what draws you to taking on line management.
* Your preferred working hours and pattern.


We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Senior Power Platform Consultant
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


Join our growing Data Analytics team within the Applied Technology Practice and play a key role in helping clients design, deliver and adopt high\-quality Power Platform solutions that improve how they manage information, automate processes and make decisions.


As a Senior Power Platform Consultant, you will combine deep technical expertise across Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate and the wider Microsoft ecosystem with a practical consulting mindset. You will work with clients and internal stakeholders to understand business challenges, shape solution options, challenge assumptions constructively and translate requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable low\-code solutions.


This is a client\-facing consulting role suited to someone who can operate as a senior technical specialist while also contributing to wider delivery leadership, capability development and business growth. You will act as a trusted advisor to project teams and clients, provide technical direction to colleagues, support bids and proposals where appropriate, and help strengthen the Power Platform capability through reusable patterns, assurance, mentoring and knowledge sharing.

**Your role**
-------------

* Lead the design, development and ongoing improvement of Power Platform solutions using Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, model\-driven apps and wider Microsoft Power Platform capabilities.
* Work with clients, project teams and internal stakeholders to understand business needs, facilitate requirements discussions and translate complex or ambiguous challenges into practical digital solutions.
* Provide advisory input on Power Platform solution options, helping stakeholders understand technical trade\-offs, delivery risks, licensing implications, governance considerations and opportunities for value.
* Configure and extend Dataverse data models, relationships, business rules, forms, views, security roles, environment settings, APIs and appropriate integration patterns.
* Develop canvas apps, model\-driven apps and Power Automate cloud flows using appropriate Power Fx, connectors, reusable components and maintainable design patterns.
* Design and support integrations with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Power BI, Azure services and external systems where appropriate.
* Own or lead Power Platform workstreams through discovery, design, build, test, deployment, adoption and continuous improvement activities.
* Investigate and resolve complex issues across apps, flows, Dataverse, connectors, permissions, integrations and deployments, applying structured problem\-solving and sound technical judgement.
* Ensure solutions align with organisational governance, cyber security, data protection, licensing, regulatory and client assurance requirements.
* Apply good ALM practices, including solution packaging, environment strategy, deployment planning, documentation, release governance and appropriate technical assurance.
* Act as a senior technical specialist within the Data Analytics and Applied Technology community, providing guidance, peer review, coaching and mentoring to junior developers and less experienced Power Platform makers.
* Contribute to the development of reusable delivery patterns, templates, standards, technical guidance and lessons learned that improve consistency, quality and scalability across Power Platform projects.
* Build trusted relationships with clients and internal stakeholders, identifying opportunities where Power Platform, automation, analytics or wider digital capability can deliver additional value.
* Support business development activity where appropriate, including contributing technical content to bids, proposals, demonstrations, case studies, solution shaping and capability development.
* Promote good practice in user\-centred design, accessibility, adoption, supportability and maintainability so that delivered solutions create lasting value beyond initial deployment.

**About you**
-------------

* Experience developing Power Platform solutions, including canvas apps, Dataverse, Power Automate and model\-driven apps.
* Strong understanding of Dataverse architecture, relational data modelling, security model, environment administration and ALM.
* Experience delivering enterprise\-grade Power Platform solutions in regulated or governance\-led environments.
* Experience using the wider Dataverse capability set, including custom connectors, APIs and appropriate integration patterns to support secure, scalable enterprise solutions.
* Good knowledge of Power Fx, Power Automate expressions, Dataverse configuration and solution deployment approaches.
* Experience integrating Power Platform with Microsoft 365 services such as SharePoint, Teams, Outlook and Power BI.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, requirements gathering and solution design skills.
* UK SC clearance required, or willingness and eligibility to obtain it where required.

**Desirable skills and experience:**

* Experience using Microsoft Copilot Studio to design, build and integrate copilots or agents with Power Platform solutions and enterprise data sources.
* Experience developing custom code components, including Power Apps Component Framework controls, using appropriate web development technologies and Microsoft development tooling.
* Experience developing and deploying Dataverse plug\-ins using C\# to implement server\-side business logic, validation and integration requirements.
* Experience developing Dataverse workflow extensions or custom workflow activities where standard Power Automate and platform capabilities are not sufficient.
* Microsoft Power Platform certifications desirable, particularly PL\-200, PL\-400, PL\-600, AB\-410, AB\-100\.

**Rewards \& benefits**
-----------------------


Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.


Rewards and benefits – Careers at AtkinsRéalis

**About AtkinsRéalis**
----------------------


We're AtkinsRéalis, a world\-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

**Additional information**
--------------------------

**Security clearance**


This role may require security clearance and offers of employment will be dependent on obtaining the relevant level of clearance. If this is necessary, it will be discussed with you at interview. The vetting process is delivered by United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) and may require candidates to provide proof of residency in the UK of 5 years or longer. If applying to this role please do not make reference to (in conversation) or include in your application or CV, details of any current or previously held security clearance.

Why work at Utilita?

**A schedule that supports your work\-life balance.**

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Advert

**About Us**

  

At **Everflow**, we’re on a mission to reshape the utility industry.

  

We’re an award\-winning, fast\-growing business delivering smarter, greener water, waste and connectivity solutions to businesses across the UK and we’re proud of the impact we make every day.

  

Our quest is simple but powerful: **bringing services together to make lives simple**. By saving our customers time, money, and energy, we give them the headspace to focus on what really matters growing their businesses and making an impact.

  

And while free coffee and ping pong are nice (very nice, actually), they’re not the reason people stay. Our culture is. We value authenticity over ego, curiosity over comfort, and progress over perfection. We trust our people, encourage bold ideas, and believe success should never come at the cost of wellbeing or belonging.

 **The Role**

  

This is where you come in.


As a **DevOps Engineer** in our Platform Team, you’ll be hands\-on with the cloud platform and pipelines our delivery teams build and ship software on. Reporting to one of our Engineering leads, you’ll work alongside colleagues in a multi\-disciplined team, take real ownership of your work, and need only light supervision to run with it.

  

This is an AI\-first role. As Everflow moves to an AI\-executed engineering model, you’ll use the AI code\-generation toolchain every day, and you’ll help keep the deployment pipeline that takes reviewed work to production fast and dependable. We’ll expect you to be comfortable reading, reviewing and correcting AI\-generated infrastructure code and your judgement about what good looks like matters.

  

In practice you’ll work across a mixed estate — greenfield AI workloads alongside established services we’re actively modernising, including .NET Framework — taking an automation\-first and AI\-first approach to delivery and designing efficient, secure cloud solutions with security considered at every layer. We’re a Microsoft house with a focus on staying cloud\-agnostic as our technology and tooling evolve.

  

You’ll be based at our Peterlee (SR8 2RU) office two days a week under our hybrid working pattern, with support for occasional planned out\-of\-hours work, such as releases and other changes best made outside business hours.

  

Candidates should expect a technical exercise as part of the selection process, which helps us understand how you think.

 **What You’ll Do**

  

You’ll be hands\-on, challenged, and trusted to make a real difference. You’ll:

  

* Build and maintain secure, scalable, highly available and cost\-optimised cloud infrastructure, collaborating on its design with our architects and the wider Platform Team.
* Use our AI code\-generation toolchain day to day, and review what it produces as carefully as you’d review your own work, automating throughput wherever possible.
* Contribute to our prompt libraries, treating prompts and AI configuration as versioned, tested code rather than throwaway text. You will help to keep our platform reliable and predictable.
* Implement and maintain infrastructure as code, as well as our CI/CD pipelines, principally in Terraform, keeping our modules and patterns reusable rather than one\-off.
* Build and manage services deployed into Kubernetes on Azure, including container configuration and the management of Helm charts.
* Monitor and manage our systems for availability and performance and help improve observability across the estate.
* Keep an eye on what we spend, applying FinOps practice to cloud resources and to AI toolchain alike.
* Work with our Security Engineers to build security into what you deploy rather than bolt it on afterwards.
* Support the team in the application of Agile through Scrum and Kanban, adopting the usual rituals and our end\-to\-end processes.

 **What We’re Looking For**

  

We’re less about ticking boxes and more about finding the right person — a team player and self\-starter who is prepared to contribute and help enrich how we do things. You’ll probably possess:

 **Essential**

* Solid experience developing, deploying and monitoring cloud infrastructure, with the judgement to analyse and diagnose problems under minimal supervision.
* Proficiency in infrastructure as code — Terraform.
* Hands\-on experience creating, monitoring and managing cloud resources in Microsoft Azure via Azure DevOps, working to the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF).
* Ability to build and manage services deployed into Kubernetes, including the role of container configuration and the management of Helm charts.
* Experience using AI to do real work — code generation, coding assistance or infrastructure automation — together with the judgement to review its output rather than take it at face value.
* Strong scripting and automation skills (PowerShell, Bash, Python, YAML), plus a readiness to keep developing that skillset.
* Enough familiarity with software development practice — source control, branching, code review and testing — to work as a peer to the software engineers you support. An understanding of code written in C\# and .NET is an advantage.
* Working awareness of cloud security and DevSecOps practice, and the habit of considering security as you build.
* Clear communication and a genuinely collaborative style, with a can\-do approach and an appetite for continual improvement.

 **Desirable**

* Familiarity with other infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Bicep.
* Cost optimisation of deployable resources following FinOps practices, including an appreciation of AI compute as a material cost class in its own right.
* Exposure to prompt\-framework\-as\-code: prompts and AI configuration treated as versioned, tested and governed libraries.
* An understanding of observability platforms and of building alerting that people act on.
* Familiarity with Linux\-based operating systems (Ubuntu) for build servers and containerised deployment.
* Experience of running AI or ML workloads on Azure, such as AKS\-hosted models or vector data stores.
* Familiarity with Azure B2C or federated account security.
* Business continuity principles, and familiarity with Amazon Web Services (AWS) in that context.

 **What We Offer**

  

We take rewarding our people seriously (and not just with biscuits). You’ll get a competitive salary with annual reviews, a generous pension of up to 8% employer contribution, and life insurance worth up to three times your salary.

  

You’ll enjoy hybrid working (up to three days from home), the option to buy or sell up to five days of annual leave, an extra celebration holiday, and enhanced parental and sickness benefits.

  

There’s also free breakfast, free parking, an on\-site gym at our Peterlee HQ, access to an EV company car scheme, and a cycle\-to\-work scheme. For your wellbeing, we offer 24/7 counselling, virtual GP access, and a healthcare cash plan covering dental, physio, and optical care because looking after people shouldn’t stop at work.

 **Equal Opportunities**

  

Everflow is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We’re committed to creating an inclusive, diverse workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and able to be themselves. Through our Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging (EDIB) policy, we ensure fair access to opportunities for all, regardless of background.

jobs.title: Standardisation Engineer
jobs.description:
At Rolls‑Royce SMR, our mission is simple and ambitious: to deliver clean, affordable and secure energy for all. Our Small Modular Reactor (SMR) technology provides a British‑designed, globally impactful solution to the world’s energy and climate challenges. We are proudly positioned to become the UK’s premier green export technology and a world leader in SMR deployment, driving innovation that supports national energy security and accelerates the journey to net‑zero.

**The Team**


You’ll join our Standardisation \& Standard Parts team — a group dedicated to reducing product variation, optimising plant‑wide consistency, and driving meaningful cost and workflow efficiencies. This team plays a critical role in ensuring our SMR design is repeatable, scalable and efficient across multiple islands, vendors, and engineering disciplines. The team collaborates widely across Engineering, Supply Chain, Commercial, CAD, Safety, EC\&I, and Civils, acting as a key integrator.

**Role Summary** **\- Standardisation Engineer**


This is a high‑impact engineering opportunity where you will help shape the SMR of the future. In this role, you will champion standardisation, variation reduction, and product optimisation, enabling the business to design and deliver an SMR that is cost‑effective, high‑quality, and globally deployable. Your work will directly influence component interfaces, supplier alignment, engineering efficiency, and the overall maturity of our plant design.

**What You Will Be Doing**


In this role, you will:

* Drive the standardisation strategy, ensuring components and products across the plant follow defined standardisation rules, tools, and processes.
* Review engineering artefacts to identify opportunities to reduce variation and enhance repeatability.
* Optimise product grouping across islands and vendors, highlighting opportunities for simplification, workflow efficiency, and resource/time savings.
* Support the creation and development of the Standard Parts Catalogue and associated engineering tools.
* Produce technical reports, ensuring clarity of compliance, rationale and decisions related to standardisation.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to align design approaches, resolve variation issues, and ensure integration across multiple teams.

**The Impact You Will Have**


Your work will directly unlock design efficiency, repeatability, and cost reduction across the entire SMR programme. By simplifying interfaces, enabling consistent design approaches and removing unnecessary complexity, you will help accelerate engineering throughput and improve programme certainty. This is a chance to influence one of the UK's most meaningful clean‑energy programmes — and to see your work directly reflected in the design and delivery of a first‑of‑a‑kind SMR.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**


We are looking for someone who brings:

* Degree or equivalent in an engineering discipline.
* Experience applying standardisation, variation reduction, or configuration control in complex engineering environments.
* Ability to review and interpret drawings, P\&IDs, GAs, and detailed engineering documentation.
* Strong stakeholder skills, collaborating confidently across engineering, suppliers and commercial teams.
* Familiarity with analytical or decision‑making tools such as AHP, and optionally tools such as PowerBI, Python, DOORS, Teamcenter.

**Location \& Hybrid Working**


We offer flexible, hybrid working with access to offices in Derby, Warrington, or Manchester. Expected on‑site frequency is typically 1–2 days per week, but this will be discussed individually during the recruitment process.

**Pay and Benefits**


We anticipate paying a salary of between £44,600 \- £55,000 DOE plus:\-

* Bonus \- Performance related target opportunity 12\.5%
* Benefits Allowance – £2,200 per annum, enabling you to create a bespoke package
* Pension \- 12% employer and 6% employee contributions.
* Holidays \- 28 days holiday (\+ public holidays) and the ability to buy or sell up to 4 days.
* Private Medical Insurance \- BUPA single cover health care
* Life Assurance \- 6x pensionable pay
* £250 \- One\-off payment for new starters for home office purchases

**Pay Range:**


£42,000\.00* 


£55,125\.00
**Why Join Us?**

  

You’ll be joining a forward\-thinking organisation that values transparency, fairness, and innovation. We offer:

* A flexible, inclusive, and supportive working environment.
* Opportunities for career growth in a rapidly scaling business.
* A culture that values diversity, innovation, and continuous learning.
  

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds. Inclusivity is important to us, and as a Disability Confident organisation, we are committed to fair, supportive, and continually improving recruitment practices that ensure everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

  

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. If you feel you meet 75% of the requirements for this role, we would love to hear from you.

  

Also, if you are considering a career move or a sector\-jump, please get in touch – we welcome applications from people with transferable skills.

**Our Application Process**

  

Due to the safety regulations within the nuclear industry, applicants will be required to participate in additional screening. These are:

* Obtaining Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) clearance
* Satisfactory completion of a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check
* Satisfactory completion of a basic financial probity check

 Contract type: Permanent
 Schedule: Full\-Time
 Location: Cambridge United Kingdom

Equans is looking for a Mobile Service BMS Engineer to join our Digital business, covering parts of Cambridge and the surrounding areas on a full time basis.

  

At Equans Digital, we aren’t just upgrading Building Management Systems; we’re collaborating with the UK’s commercial and public sectors to build a 'Smart Enabled' future.

  

Supported by an ambitious 5\-year growth strategy and projects ranging up to £1\.5m, we are looking for a team to help us grow sustainably.

  

**Key activities:**

As a Mobile BMS Service Engineer, you will manage a variety of essential planned and reactive tasks across our diverse portfolio, Schools, Hospitals, Offices, Business Parks and Government Buildings. Your day\-to\-day will involve:

* **Preventative Maintenance:** Carrying out scheduled maintenance checks on BMS systems and components to ensure smooth operation across various sites.
  

* **Reactive Calls:** Responding to breakdowns when things go wrong. This role involves participating in a reactive call\-out rota, which includes additional financial benefits for on\-call availability and attendance.
  

* **Continuous Improvement** : Working with other engineer colleagues to help make recommendations to our clients to enhance system performance and energy efficiency. This will require teams to complete thorough reports and build up clear cost estimates \& quotes for system enhancements.
  

**Skills, Qualifications \& Experience**

* City \& Guild / BTEC / NVQ in Electrical or BEMS
* Knowledge and Experience of at least one of the following (additional training can be provided depending on the area requirements at a later date):
* + Trend
	+ Tridium
	+ Distech
	+ Siemens
	+ Niagara
* Knowledge \& experience of HVAC and mechanical systems in a commercial environment
* Full UK Driving License
* BPSS vetting
  

**What can we offer you**

* Company car
* Enhanced pension scheme
* 24 days annual leave
* Enhanced family leave
* Life Cover equivalent to 1x annual salary
* 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app
* Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
* Gym membership discounts
* Holiday purchase scheme
* 2 corporate social responsibility days per year
* Cycle to work scheme
* Broad range of learning opportunities, such as professional qualifications, collective/individual training, and personalized support programmes
* Attractive Employee Referral Rewards Scheme
* Access to our growing employee networks including WiE (Women in EQUANS), RISE (BAME), LGBTQI\+, Working Parents, YPN (Young Persons Network) and our Disability Network

 Contract type: Permanent
 Schedule: Full\-Time

 Offer ID: 74742
**Job Title:** Mobile A/C Engineer
  

**Location:** South of England (Field\-Based)
  

**Business Unit:** MTS South
  

**Working Hours:** Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM


### **About the Role**

Are you an experienced Air Conditioning Engineer looking for a new challenge in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment? EQUANS is seeking a **Mobile A/C Engineer** to join our MTS South team, supporting a variety of critical sites across the South of England.

  

This is a great opportunity to play a key role in maintaining essential temperature control systems, minimising downtime, and delivering a first\-class service to our clients. If you’re technically skilled, self\-motivated, and thrive in a mobile role with real responsibility. This could be your next career move.


### **Key Responsibilities**

* Fault\-finding and repair of air conditioning systems, refrigeration units, chiller plants, and associated controls
* Maintain and update F\-Gas logbooks, ensuring accurate records of refrigerant use and leak testing
* Carry out installation, pressure testing, vacuum dehydration, and commissioning of A/C systems
* Oversee and coordinate subcontractor works on site
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations, including completion of all required documentation
* Complete real\-time job updates using CAFM systems via PDA/tablet
* Diagnose system defects, prepare quotations, and liaise with contract managers and clients
* Participate in an out\-of\-hours call\-out rota to provide emergency support when needed
* Work flexibly and professionally, maintaining a high standard of presentation and communication on client sites

* Recognised apprenticeship (EITB, CITB) or equivalent technical qualifications
* Minimum NVQ Level 2 in Air Conditioning and Refrigeration
* C\&G 2079\-11 F\-Gas Category 1 qualification (ODS regulations)
* Experience working with chillers, cold rooms, VRV/VRF systems, AHUs, cooling towers, and BMS systems
* Comfortable reading and interpreting mechanical and electrical schematics
* L8 Awareness (Legionella)
* Health \& Safety qualification (e.g. NEBOSH/IOSH) is advantageous
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Full UK driving licence required

### **Why Join Us?**

At EQUANS, we believe in investing in our people. When you join us, you’re part of a global organisation committed to innovation, sustainability, and development.

* Competitive salary
* Ongoing training and professional development
* Opportunity to work across a diverse portfolio of sites
* Supportive team culture with career progression routes

EQUANS is a global leader in energy, technical, and facilities services, with more than 100,000 employees in over 50 countries. EQUANS is part of the Bouygues Group, one of the world’s most respected names in construction and engineering.

If you're a skilled A/C engineer ready for your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Submit your CV and a short cover letter detailing your relevant experience.

  

**Please note:** Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. This role involves travel across multiple sites and participation in an out\-of\-hours call\-out rota.

 Contract type: Permanent

 Location: Cambridge United Kingdom
 Offer ID: 74067
Equans is a renowned energies \& services contractor and a proud member of the Bouygues global industrial group. Our expertise spans the design, construction, and maintenance of buildings and critical infrastructure worldwide. We have an exciting new opportunity for an intermediate Electrical Design Engineer interested in decarbonisation projects to join our Carbon Shift business unit. Our Carbon Shift consulting business is focussed on the delivery of realisable climate action and net zero plans and is supported by delivery capability in heat decarbonisation, regeneration, Facilities Management, Project delivery, EV’s, smart buildings and renewables. * To utilise application specific software, such as PVSyst and Dialux
* Prepare calculations and engineering analysis for the purpose of validating simulation models, confirming systems design requirements and performances

* Interpret survey information from others and accommodate within design

* Competent in standard Microsoft Office products i.e. word, excel, outlook, teams etc.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (.NET)
jobs.description:
**Who are Benifex?**


We are a fast\-moving technology company, and **one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world.** We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build **workplace technology** that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to **build remarkable experiences that employees love.** Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best, **we need brilliant people** on board and that’s where you come in.


**Why should you apply?**

* **Impact:** AI first by default, we’re building our SDLC around AI Assisted engineering and you’ll be part of shaping this.
* **Technology:** Gain experience working with cutting\-edge technologies and architectural practice on a product used by millions.
* **Team**: Work with a talented, experience group of engineers dedicated to building high quality product for our users.
* **Sunday Times Best Place to Work 2025** and **Best Large Tech Company to Work for 2025**
* Work for a **profitable, fast\-growing** **market leader** in the online reward and benefits space
**Role Overview**

Our Engineering department is looking for Senior .Net developers to help shape the future of our platform and engineering department! We are going through a key period of growth across the business and have roles within existing teams delivering key functionality, as well as brand new teams set up to achieve our goals as a business.


Please note we are unable to offer visa sponsorship and require to people to be based in the UK or Ireland for this position

**Great benefits:**


£75,000\-90,000


Tech setup of your choice (MacBook Pro or equivalent, monitors, etc.)


£/€800 annual learning budget, plus two hours per week as ‘Focus Fridays’.


Flexible work – choose a working setup that works for you, our only ask is to see you once a month in the office and you must be based in the UK or Ireland.


Full access to our comprehensive benefits package, including discounts from hundreds of high street brands, salary sacrifice schemes across Finance, Health, Tech, and more


️ 25 days holiday plus your local bank holidays


Your birthday off


️ Two half day wellbeing days


Healthcare cash plan to cover the costs of day\-to\-day healthcare


Employee Assistance Plan 24/7 365 support


Income Protection (75%) and life assurance (4x salary)


Referral bonuses


Enhanced parental leave package \- 26 weeks fully paid maternity leave and 4 weeks fully paid paternity leave


️ Work from Anywhere policy for 90 days


️ Buy and Sell scheme for holidays


£50 monthly allowance to spend on whatever takes your fancy, your very own Benifex card will be topped up at the start of each month!

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and development of modern, scalable backend solutions for our Benefits product using C\#.NET and .NET Core.
* Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams to define technical requirements, ensure high\-quality delivery, and drive architectural decisions.
* Modernise existing systems by introducing microservices, containerisation (Kubernetes), and cloud\-native practices.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless deployment and delivery processes.
* Advocate for and implement best practices in coding, architecture, and process, ensuring a high standard of technical excellence.
* Work effectively with remote teams to deliver cohesive and robust solutions.
* Collaborate with engineers from Java Spring Boot backgrounds to ensure seamless integration and knowledge sharing.

**Tech stack**: .NET, SQL, GCP, MSMQ (moving to Google Pub/Sub), Kubernetes.

 **What are we looking for?**

* Extensive experience in backend development with **C\#.NET and .NET Core**, with a focus on scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Proven knowledge of **Kubernetes** and **containerisation** to support modern infrastructure practices.
* Experience with **modern architectural patterns**, including microservices, CQRS and event\-driven systems. Bonus points for experience with circuit breaker, transient fault handling, outbox patterns, dead letter handling
* Hands\-on experience with messaging systems like **Pub/Sub, distributed transaction coordination (MSDTC)**, and caching solutions like Redis.
* Proven ability to set up and maintain **CI/CD pipeline**s to streamline development and deployment workflows.
* Solid understanding of system performance, optimisation, and debugging.
* **Collaboration**: Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional and remote teams, including Java Spring Boot engineers, to deliver cohesive solutions.
* **Proactive Problem\-Solving:** A resourceful approach to tackling complex challenges and driving projects forward with minimal guidance.
* **Technical Excellence:** A strong advocate for clean code, best practices, and high\-quality software development.

**Bonus Points for:**

* Experience with cloud technologies, particularly in deploying and scaling .NET applications.
* Familiarity with observability tools for monitoring, logging, and alerting (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus).
* Knowledge of IaC tools such as Terraform.
* Previous experience modernising legacy systems or transitioning monolithic architectures to microservices.

  

Even if you don't meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply! We are looking for talented and passionate individuals who are eager to learn and grow. We also offer a variety of other roles, so please check out our careers page to see if there is something else that might be a good fit for you.

**Our interview process**


Benifex understands the need to have a fast and efficient process, the below will all be completed in the shortest time possible.


Initial informal call with the Talent team


Interview with our Engineering Manager 30 min


Technical Task


Technical Interview \- 60 min


Final interview with VP of Engineering \- 30\-45 min

**We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected. We believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to our success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.**

**Job Description:**

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for a Junior R\&D Electrical Engineer to join our Global Multi‑physics Simulation Team within the Transformers business. In this role, you will support the development of advanced dry‑type and liquid‑filled distribution and traction transformers by performing circuit‑level, electromagnetic, and multi‑physics simulations.


You will work in a global, cross‑functional R\&D environment with strong interaction with engineering, testing, and product development teams, contributing to a shift‑left approach where simulations are used to predict product performance early in the development cycle and anticipate factory test results.


**How you’ll make an impact:**

* Perform circuit‑level, electromagnetic, and multiphysics simulations of all typical performance measures of dry‑type and liquid‑filled distribution and traction transformers, in accordance with relevant international standards (e.g. IEC, IEEE).
* Evaluate transformer performance parameters such as losses, impedance, leakage fields, short‑circuit forces, inductances, and transient behavior using circuit‑level and electromagnetic finite\-element (FEM) simulations.
* Apply circuit‑level, electromagnetic, and multi‑physics simulations to support a shift‑left development strategy, aiming to predict the outcome of Factory Acceptance Tests early in the design phase and reduce design iterations, testing effort, and development risk for dry‑type and liquid‑filled distribution and traction transformers.
* Develop and maintain automation tools and simulation workflows for circuit‑level, electromagnetic, and multiphysics simulations, explicitly focused on early design validation and FAT prediction.
* Develop new multi‑physics simulation methodologies by coupling circuit‑level and electromagnetic models with: Structural mechanics simulations, Thermomechanical simulations, Acoustic simulations
* Support feasibility studies, development of new technical concepts, and simulation‑based assessment of new technologies and product variants related to dry‑type and liquid‑filled distribution and traction transformers.
* Contribute to the design and performance prediction of dry‑type and liquid‑filled distribution and traction transformers.
* Support and organize prototyping and testing activities to validate simulation models and new technologies.
* Support product and technology development projects, contributing to delivery in line with agreed scope, time, cost, and quality.
* Support the transfer of technology and know‑how from R\&D to Engineering by:, Writing design rules and technical guidelines, Preparing and delivering internal technical trainings, Collaborating closely with design tools and engineering teams

* Provide technical support to other departments (Engineering, Product Management, Marketing, Sales) when required.

**Your background**

* M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering.
* Initial professional experience in **electrical engineering** , preferably with exposure to **transformer design** , is an advantage.
* Strong theoretical foundation in circuit theory, electromagnetics, and transformer physics for dry‑type and liquid‑filled distribution and traction transformers.
* Preferred: knowledge of transformer performance prediction, including: Impedance and transient behavior, Leakage fields, Stray and no‑load losses, Short‑circuit forces, Mutual inductances and related parameters
* Preferred: experience with electromagnetic finite element analysis (FEA) using one or more tools such as: ANSYS Maxwell, COMSOL Multiphysics, Altair Flux, FEMM, other EM FEM‑based tools
* Preferred: experience or familiarity with circuit‑level simulation tools, such as: LTspice, PSpice, Ansys TwinBuilder/Simplorer or equivalent circuit simulation environment
* Knowledge of at least one programming language:, Python, MATLAB, C\#
* Exposure to or interest in electrical testing of dry‑type and liquid‑filled distribution and traction transformers is an advantage.
* Basic project management capabilities and willingness to take ownership of tasks.
* Action‑ and results‑oriented mindset combined with strong analytical skills.
* Innovative spirit and motivation to apply simulation‑driven, “out‑of‑the‑box” approaches.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

jobs.title: Senior System Developer
jobs.description:
Vi söker en Senior System Developer till vårt team inom Commercial Technology på Nobina. Är du en driven fullstackutvecklare med gedigen erfarenhet inom .NET och ett starkt intresse för att utveckla stabila och användarvänliga lösningar? Då kan du vara den vi söker!


Nobina är Nordens ledande aktör inom kollektivtrafik, med cirka 15 000 medarbetare som dagligen bidrar till att en miljon resenärer når sina destinationer på ett hållbart sätt. Vår verksamhet sträcker sig över Sverige, Norge, Danmark och Finland.

##### **Om rollen**


Som Senior System Developer får du en central roll i utvecklingen och förbättringen av vårt Tågersättningssystem (TRIP), som hanterar ersättningstrafik vid trafikavbrott och extratrafik vid större evenemang. Du arbetar i ett agilt, tvärfunktionellt team med utvecklare, testare, kravställare och produktägare, i nära samarbete med verksamheten och övriga IT. Den tekniska miljön består främst av .NET, Angular och Azure.

* Utveckla, förbättra och underhålla våra system och appar
* Bidra i tekniska och arkitekturella frågor samt ta fram lösningar för tekniska och affärsmässiga behov
* Delta i kravhantering och tekniska tester.
* Bidra till kunskapsdelning och gott samarbete i teamet

##### **Vem är du?**


Du är en erfaren och lösningsorienterad utvecklare med god kunskap inom backend och gärna även frontend. Du trivs i komplexa systemlandskap, arbetar självständigt med felsökning och problemlösning och samarbetar väl i agila team. Du har ett starkt intresse för teknik, systemutveckling och kontinuerliga förbättringar.


För att lyckas i rollen har du:

* Minst 8 års erfarenhet som utvecklare och relevant utbildning inom IT
* Erfarenhet av systemarkitektur och utveckling av händelsebaserade distribuerade system
* Erfarenhet av monitorering och felsökning i affärskritiska system

* Azure DevOps

* Mobilutveckling i .NET MAUI, Blazor eller Xamarin
* Arkitektur och arbete i större IT\-projekt

##### **Varför Nobina**


På Nobina är vi engagerade i att skapa en inkluderande arbetsmiljö där varje medarbetare gör skillnad. Våra ledare tar ansvar, fattar modiga beslut och strävar alltid efter att möta våra resenärers och samhällets behov. Genom att vara affärsdrivna och fokusera på helheten strävar vi efter att utveckla vår verksamhet och skapa hållbara lösningar, för idag och för framtiden. På ett coachande sätt är vi engagerande. Vår kultur bygger på respekt, vi bryr oss och tar ansvar, och vi söker ständigt nya perspektiv för att driva innovation.


Låter det intressant?Vänta inte med din ansökan, urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Välkommen att bli en del av Nobina!

Vår hybridmodell, som kombinerar fysiska vårdcentraler med moderna digitala lösningar, har gjort oss till den största digitala vårdgivaren i Sverige, med miljontals konsultationer varje år.

### **Om uppdraget**


Vi söker en erfaren Backend\- och DevOps\-konsult för ett uppdrag hos Kollarna.se, en tjänst som erbjuds av Doktor.se:s dotterbolag Doktor24\.se. Vi vill arbeta direkt med dig som konsult, utan mellanhänder.


Uppdraget syftar till att stärka och modernisera Kollarnas infrastruktur i Azure, med fokus på säkerhet, skalbarhet och automatisering. Du arbetar i nära samarbete med Kollarnas utvecklingsteam och driver dina leveranser självständigt mot överenskomna mål.

### **Vad uppdraget innebär**


Uppdraget omfattar följande leveranser:

* Genomlysning av nuvarande Azure\-miljö och säkerhetsläge, med prioriterade åtgärdsförslag.
* Införande av infrastructure as code för befintliga tjänster.
* Översyn och förenkling av CI/CD\-pipelines i GitHub Actions.
* Uppsättning av monitorering och larm, samt översyn av skalbarhet, t.ex. databaser och cachning (Redis).
* Rådgivning i design\- och arkitekturfrågor som rör leveranserna ovan.
* Dokumentation och överlämning till teamet vid uppdragets slut.

### **Vem vi söker**


Du har gärna 5 år eller mer som backendutvecklare med erfarenhet av DevOps, som infrastrukturingenjör eller i liknande roll, framför allt i Azure\-miljöer (erfarenhet av AWS är meriterande). Kollarnas backend är skriven i C\# .NET och frontend i TypeScript/React. Erfarenhet av TypeScript och/eller Python är meriterande.


Du kan drifta Azure\-tjänster med hjälp av exempelvis GitHub Actions, har god erfarenhet av databaser och SQL, framför allt MS SQL, och vet hur man bäst utnyttjar Azure\-tjänster och sätter upp exempelvis Redis. Du har erfarenhet av att sätta upp och underhålla monitorering, tänker säkerhet först och har gedigen kunskap om hur man skyddar infrastruktur mot intrång.


Du är van att driva uppdrag självständigt och leverera mot överenskomna mål, samarbetar gärna och har erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt. Du talar och skriver flytande svenska och engelska.

### **Varför uppdraget är intressant**


Kollarna är en tjänst som hjälper människor varje dag, och infrastrukturen bakom den behöver vara säker, stabil och skalbar. Här får du ett tydligt avgränsat uppdrag med verklig effekt, stort mandat inom ditt område och ett engagerat team att samarbeta med.

### **Uppdragsvillkor**

**Uppdragsform:** Direktuppdrag. Du fakturerar via eget bolag med F\-skatt, helst aktiebolag.

**Uppdragslängd:** Enligt överenskommelse.

**Omfattning:** 40 timmar per vecka.

**Start:** Så snart som möjligt. Vi tar hänsyn till eventuella pågående uppdrag.

**Arbetsplats:** Uppdraget utförs delvis på plats i Göteborg (Första Långgatan 18\) för samarbete och avstämningar, enligt överenskommelse.

**Ersättning:** Enligt överenskommelse. Ange gärna ditt timpris i ansökan.

**Övrigt:** Uppdraget kan kombineras med andra uppdrag, så länge det inte innebär en intressekonflikt.

### **Var med och gör skillnad i vården!**


Som en del av vår urvalsprocess genomför vi ID\-kontroll och begär utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Vi söker konsulter som vill arbeta direkt med oss och ber därför vänligt men bestämt att konsultmäklare, konsultbolag och rekryteringsföretag avstår från att kontakta oss.
