jobs.title: Civil Environmental Engineer (Engineer Grade 2) - Barriers Mitigation Division
jobs.description:
Inland Fisheries Ireland (IFI) has an exciting opportunity for a Civil Environmental Engineer (Engineer Grade 2\) to join our Barrier Mitigation Division.

  

The Barrier Mitigation Division is a newly created team within IFI.


IFI has been asked to take on the role of managing a newly established National Barrier Mitigation Programme 2024 \- 2030 (NBMP) and as such, this new division has been established with funding from the Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage (DHLGH) and Department of the Environment, Climate and Communications (DECC).

  

This role will provide an exciting opportunity for an individual with civil engineering experience in the ecological/environmental arena, to play a leading advisory role on the remediation works required to successfully mitigate or remove barriers.


The aim of the National Barrier Mitigation Programme is to improve river hydromorphology and connectivity in Irish catchments by strategically targeting significant barriers to fish passage and structures degrading river form, flow and function. Iconic species such as Atlantic salmon and the European eel are threatened species and IFI is mandated to protect them under law. Removing barriers will open up habitat to various species in an era where habitat loss is impacting severely on biodiversity both nationally and internationally.

  

Reporting to the Civil Engineer (Grade 1\), this role will provide an exciting opportunity for an individual with civil engineering experience in the ecological/environmental arena, to play a leading advisory role on the remediation works required to successfully mitigate or remove barriers. The Engineer on this project will be an expert on the planning and management of remediation works concerning barrier mitigation and have the ability to understand the impacts of ecosystem dynamics associated with barrier removal and mitigation.

 **ABOUT US**


Inland Fisheries Ireland are the environmental agency responsible for protecting, managing and conserving Ireland's inland fisheries and sea angling resources.


More information can be found by visiting our website.  

  

**VISION, MISSION \& VALUES**

**Vision**


To place the inland fisheries resource in the best sustainable position possible for the benefit of future generations.

**Mission**


To protect, manage and conserve Ireland’s inland fisheries and sea angling resources and to maximise their sustainability and natural biodiversity.

**Values**

* We are committed to the environment and sustainability.
* We work collaboratively and with professionalism.
* We communicate openly and transparently.
* We act with respect, integrity, and accountability

 **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Work alongside the Civil Environmental Engineer (Grade 1\) to recruit and train a team of civil and environmental design experts to support delivery of the NBMP.
* Undertake, or assist in the management of projects and technical assessments, studies or research in connection with the areas of activity of the Barriers Mitigation Division.
* Work closely with colleagues from the Barriers Mitigation Research Programme to obtain and review data from a range of sources such as; site assessments, environmental monitoring and third party reports and design proposals.
* Evaluate the environmental impacts of the proposed barrier mitigation options.
* Undertake design tasks including calculations, testing and assessment of proposed remediation works.
* Undertake supervision of consultants and review of technical reports and studies produced, including assisting in choosing optimum design solutions
* Prepare and present findings, technical documents, costings, and recommendations on proposed remediation works.
* Plan and manage remediation works concerning barrier mitigation and removal.
* Plan, implement, manage and supervise the day\-to\-day tasks of construction and remediation schemes including evaluation of costings.
* Organise, direct and supervise site investigation, project construction and maintenance including direction and supervision of direct labour force and contractors working on barrier mitigation projects.
* Contribute to the development of site\-specific health and safety plans, Standard Operating Procedures and Risk Assessment Method Statements.
* Foster collaborative and strategic relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, vendors and technical service providers
* Engage with procurement activities, in line with IFI policies and public sector procurement guidelines to deliver the programme of mitigation works.
* Comply with the policies and standards of Inland Fisheries Ireland and the Code of Practice for the Governance of State Bodies.Perform such other duties as may be assigned from time to time by the Civil/ Environmental Engineer (Grade 1\) or nominee.

 **KEY EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS**


The ideal candidate must, on or before the closing date have the following;

**Essential**

* A recognised third\-level qualification, at a minimum level of NFQ Level 8 (Honours Bachelor degree) in Civil Engineering or Environmental Engineering or Structural Engineering, accredited by Engineers Ireland;
* A minimum of 3\-years' demonstrable post\-qualification professional experience working in a relevant civil and/or environmental engineering role.
* On the date of appointment, the successful candidate must possess a current full clean driving licence (Category B) that is recognised in Ireland, as they be required to drive in the course of their duties.
* Eligible to work full\-time in the State and meet the citizenship requirements for the role
* Experience in the project management of major civil engineering works.
* Demonstrable familiarity with the planning application processes and requirements in Local Authorities.
* A proven track record of fostering productive relationships with external stakeholders, including sub\-contractors and/or sub\-consultants.

**Desirable**

* Interest in working in, or experience in the design, construction or evaluation of civil engineering projects, in particular; bridges, weirs, culverts, crossings, or other river infrastructure.
* Experience working with diverse stakeholders involved in the ecology arena.
* An excellent knowledge of ecological principles and a familiarity with fisheries conservation and environmental legislation, in particular the Water Framework Directive, as well as other relevant legislation.
* Experience and familiarity with the Capital Works Management Framework, Infrastructure Guidelines (Public Spending Code), Public Procurement Policy standards, relevant legislative requirements and applicable national and European policy.
* A knowledge of current Health and Safety legislative requirements and an awareness of progressive legislative changes relevant to the field of Civil / Environmental engineering.
* Experience working in the riverine environment is highly desirable.

 **KEY SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES**

 **Essential**

* Ability to meet the travel requirements of the post, such as site visits, and a willingness to work outside of normal hours as necessary.
* Demonstrable project management skills, with a capability to achieve deliverables on time and within budget.
* Strong IT skills including MS Office suite, MS Project, GIS / ArcGIS, AutoCAD (or equivalent) and BIM systems.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to express technical matters in plain language to non\-technical individuals.
* Excellent people management and leadership skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Outstanding time management and resource management skills.
* A passion for the environment.

 **LOCATION**


This role may be based at either of the following IFI regional offices; Citywest, Dublin / Galway City, Galway/ Ballina, Mayo/Limerick City, Limerick


Inland Fisheries Ireland is proud to offer a hybrid working model for this role which will typically consist of 2\-days working remotely and 3\-days working from the successful candidate's designated office, subject to business requirements and approval from line management.

 **REMUNERATION**


The salary scale for the position is at the level of Engineer Grade 2 as applies in Inland Fisheries Ireland**.** This is an 8\-point scale including 2 long service increments (LSI’s): **Point 1 €76,202\.05 Point 2 €77,944\.10 Point 3 €79,680\.79; Point 4 €81,424\.99 Point 5 €83,164\.89; Point 6 €83,628\.01; Point 7 €85,344\.33; Point 8 €87,123\.90 Point 9 (LSI 1\) €90,023\.74****Point 10 (LSI 2\)****€92,930\.01** *(IFI Engineer Grade 1 PayScale as of 01/06/2026\).*

 *Candidates should note that salary will not be subject to negotiation and the rate of remuneration may be adjusted from time to time in line with Government pay policy. New entrants to the public sector will start on point 1 subject to Haddington Road Agreement and subsequent Government Agreements.*

 **ANNUAL LEAVE**


The annual leave entitlement for this role is 30 days per annum (pro\-rata) and is subject to the usual conditions regarding the granting of annual leave as per the Annual Leave policy of Inland Fisheries Ireland.

 **HOURS OF ATTENDANCE**


Hours of attendance will be as fixed from time to time. At present they amount to 35 hours per week (full\-time), net of breaks.


The successful candidate will be required to work such additional hours from time to time as may be reasonable and necessary for the proper performance of their duties, subject to the limits set down in the working time regulations.  

  

  



**TENURE**

  

This post is offered on Specified Purpose Contract linked to funding which is expected to last until the end of 2030\.

 **APPLICATIONS \& SELECTION PROCESS**


A cover letter and up to date Curriculum Vitae should be submitted via this website by **5\.00 pm** on **Friday 23rd October 2026**.


Late applications or applications not received through the correct channel, as indicated above, will not be considered.


Canvassing will disqualify.


Short listing will be based on information provided in the Cover Letter and CV.

 **FORMATION OF PANEL**


A panel may be created for up to six months to cover vacancies for roles with similar skill sets.

 **Inland Fisheries Ireland is an equal opportunities employer.**

jobs.title: Software Developer - Praktikant
jobs.description:
**Praktik forår 2027**
----------------------


Brænder du for at lære mere om softwareteknologi i god kombi med lysten til at udvikle webapplikationer, databaseløsninger, mobilapplikationer eller lignende? Og er du motiveret for at hjælpe kunder med at forbedre deres arbejdsgange og \-processer? Så er IT Minds måske det helt rette sted for dig?

### **Dit praktikophold**


Som praktikant hos IT Minds kommer du ikke til at sidde i et hjørne og lave bugfixing eller drift af legacy systemer. Tværtimod kommer du til at arbejde med nye projekter og de nyeste teknologier på markedet.


Som udgangspunkt vil du blive en del af et projekt, hvor du hjælper med at udvikle en skræddersyet, softwareteknologisk løsning til internt brug eller til en af vores kunder. Uanset hvad sørger vi for, at du hele tiden er i tæt dialog og sparring med vores dygtige senior udviklere. Om du ender på et kundeprojekt eller en intern løsning afhænger af de potentielle muligheder, som vi har i forretningen på det givne tidspunkt, men du kommer i hvert fald ikke til at blive alene!


... Men én ting er sikkert: Du kommer til at udvikle dine tekniske skills og dygtiggøre dig med hjælp fra nogle af Danmarks skarpeste Software Developers.


I mere grove træk vil du i et praktikforløb hos IT Minds få:

* 20 ugers lønnet praktik normeret til 37 timer/uge
* 14 dages onboardingforløb med en grundig introduktion til vores forretning og koncept, introduktion til professionel softwareudvikling, et kursus i "Mindster Consulting Class" og meget mere...
* Et stærkt fællesskab og en særdeles uformel omgangstone, hvor det er helt legalt at spille et slag bordfodbold eller prøve vores crockinole board, når dit hoved trænger til et break
* Gratis frokostordning, kaffe, Cola og Nutella ad libitum


Vi har en historik for at ansætte vores dygtige praktikanter, sådan så du kan tage næste skridt i dit \#Mindsterlife og potentielt overgå fra praktikant til studieprogrammør aka Software Developer på deltid. Muligheden for det kan vi vende, når dit praktikophold lakker mod enden


... Og så er der jo alt det løse \- men vigtige, for vi hepper også på, at du har lyst til at spise fredagsrundstykker med dine kollegaer og skåle i en fredagsøl, serveret fra vores Tiki\-Bar. Måske melder du dig ind i brætspilsklubben eller strikkeklubben? Eller er med til fællestræning hver tirsdag i den lokale fitnesskæde?


Mulighederne er mange, og det er helt fair, hvis du mister pusten ved at deltage i det hele. Så joiner du bare det, du synes, er fedest \- eller opfinder dit eget Mindster\-event!

#### **Din faglige og personlige profil**

* Du er sandsynligvis i gang med din bachelor i Softwareteknologi, Sundhedsteknologi eller en af de andre lignende uddannelser på Institut for Elektro\- og Computerteknologi i Aarhus
* Du er passioneret for software og brænder for at lære mere
* Du har kendskab til .NET\-platformen (C\#) eller Java og/eller JavaScript, og måske har du endda lidt erfaring med frameworks som eksempelvis ASP.NET, .NET core, Angular, React eller Vue.js samt SQL og NoSQL databaser, fx MongoDB
* Du er flydende på dansk i både skrift og tale

#### **IT Minds**


Samler unge IT\-talenter ét sted, og vi omgås hinanden i et miljø, der bærer præg af en høj grad af fleksibilitet, tillid og en særdeles uformel omgangstone.


På IT Minds kontor i Aarhus er vi ca. 50 medarbejdere i en god blanding af erfarne kræfter krydret med studerende og nyuddannede, der befinder sig i begyndelsen af deres karriere.


Som forretning har vi fokus på høj faglighed og kvalitet kombineret med de nyeste teknologier på markedet. Vigtigst er det at levere et stærkt produkt, der skaber værdi og mening, for vores kunder står højest på dagsordenen, og derfor arbejder vi også både agilt og gennemsigtigt. Vores tilgang til arbejdet er derfor ret simpel \- vores softwareløsninger optimerer forretningsprocesser og minimerer omkostningerne. Det er fremtidens softwareløsninger udviklet af nutidens unge talenter.

#### **Vil du være praktikant hos os?**


Søg stillingen på formularen i bunden af siden. Husk at vedhæfte dit karakterudskrift.


Har du spørgsmål så kontakt Rune Østergaard, Team Lead, på rune.ostergaard@it\-minds.dk

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer (Agentic AI Platform)
jobs.description:
Banksektoren står midt i et markant skifte. Stigende kundekrav og kompleks drift udfordrer den klassiske måde at levere rådgivning og service på. Samtidig bygger meget af rådgivningen på mønstre og data – og her kan kunstig intelligens bidrage til at reducere omkostninger, forbedre relationerne til kunderne og gøre bankerne mere konkurrencedygtige.


I Bankdata har vi de seneste år opbygget erfaring med både klassisk Machine Learning, LLM\-baseret søgning i forretningsgange og AI\-agenter til mere komplekse opgaver og hyper\-personaliserede løsninger. Det har lagt et solidt fundament for vores videre arbejde.


Nu er vi klar til næste skridt. Ambitionen er klar: Kunstig intelligens er en central del af Bankdatas tilbud til vores kunder. Derfor bygger vi Bankdatas Agent Platform \- den fælles platform til at udvikle, deploye, drifte og governere AI\-agenter på tværs af Bankdata og pengeinstitutterne.


Ligesom vores containerplatform giver et standardiseret eksekveringsmiljø for applikationer, skal Agent Platform give et standardiseret eksekveringsmiljø for AI\-agenter. Og vi starter ikke fra bar bund: i platformen Horizon har Bankdata allerede et stærkt koncept for containerafvikling, som store dele af forretningen kører på. Det fundament – og de platformkompetencer, der er bygget op omkring det – er det, vi tager med videre. Opgaven nu er at løfte det til workloads, der opfører sig anderledes end klassiske applikationer, og som kræver deres egne guardrails.

**Centralisér kompleksiteten, decentralisér værdiskabelsen.** Sikkerhed, kvalitet, compliance, IAM, forklarlighed, sporbarhed og input/output\-kontrol hører til platformen. Intelligens, integration og forretningslogik hører til den, der bygger agenten.

**Rollen: Fra golden path til selvbetjent produktion**
------------------------------------------------------


Du bliver en nøgleprofil i at gøre det nemt, sikkert og skalerbart at bygge og drive agenter.


Det betyder, at du ikke kun arbejder med LLM'er og agentframeworks, men i høj grad med det, der gør løsningerne holdbare: infrastruktur, automatisering, identitet, observability og developer experience.


Agent\-workloads er ikke stateless services: de er ikke\-deterministiske, de koster penge per kald, de har brug for deres egen identitet, de holder state på tværs af genstarter, og de stopper op og venter på et menneske. Platformen skal bygges til det.

**Du kommer til at:**

* Bygge golden paths frem for skræddersyede løsninger per team, og automatisere provisionering, onboarding, compliance\-checks og telemetri
* Bygge sikkerhed og compliance ind i platformen, så hver agent arver dem frem for at hvert team implementerer sit eget
* Sikre hård isolation mellem institutter, så én tenant aldrig kan påvirke en andens agenter eller data – og designe blast radius, så en fejl ét sted bliver ét sted
* Udvikle platformens agent\-primitiver: et hosted tool\-server\-lag med authentication, authorisation, rate limiting og audit, policy as code, tracing og struktureret logging, sandboxed eksekvering samt kontroller for prompt injection, PII og content filtering
* Bygge godkendelsesmekanismen, en agent venter på, når et menneske skal beslutte – så human\-in\-the\-loop er en platformkapabilitet frem for noget, hver agent opfinder
* Etablere cost attribution per team, agent og use case \- inklusive token\- og inferensomkostninger
* Arbejde med agent\-identitet og delegeret autorisation samt session\- og state\-persistens, så en agents arbejde overlever en genstart


Du vil arbejde på tværs af stacken men med en tydelig tyngde i platform, infrastruktur og developer experience.

**Hvad succes ser ud som efter 6–12 måneder**
---------------------------------------------

* Du har været med til at bygge og lancere den første golden path, som andre teams reelt bygger deres agenter på
* Mindst én agent er i produktion hos reelle brugere, uden at teamet bag skulle bygge sikkerhed, IAM, audit og sporbarhed selv
* Deployment af agenter er blevet selvbetjening \- de fleste deployments kræver ikke hjælp fra platformteamet
* Observability, resiliens og compliance kommer by default frem for som eftertanke
* Der er etableret cost attribution per team, agent og use case, så forbruget kan forklares og styres

**Teamet: Nyt platformteam til at sætte standarden**
----------------------------------------------------


Du bliver en del af et nyt platformteam, der bygger Bankdatas Agent Platform. Teamet er under opbygning og etableres løbende, mens vi implementerer platformen. Vi bygger den i tæt samarbejde med vores pengeinstitutter \- og platformen er ikke kun til Bankdatas egne udviklere. Et pengeinstitut skal kunne bygge og sætte agenter i produktion på lige vilkår med en Bankdata\-udvikler, uden at have os i loopet.


Det er et platformteam \- ikke et applikationsteam. Vi bygger kapabiliteter, der gør mange andre teams i stand til at bygge AI\-drevne produkter.


Fordi teknologilandskabet flytter sig hurtigt, leder vi ikke efter nogen, der "har gjort det her før". Vi leder efter erfarne ingeniører, der har lyst til at være med til at definere, hvordan det bør gøres.


Der er stort ansvar for eget arbejde og fokus på fremdrift. Sparring foregår gennem pair work, workshops og løbende tekniske drøftelser.

**Profilen vi søger: Platform engineer, der tænker platform som produkt**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------


Vi leder efter dig, der ved, at en agent i produktion er langt mere end en model – platformen rundt om modellen er det, der skal bygges én gang og virke hver gang.

**Du har erfaring med:**

* Cloudplatforme, microservices og distribuerede systemer
* Kubernetes, containerplatforme, multi\-tenancy og moderne platform engineering
* CI/CD, infrastructure as code og automatisering
* Observability, skalerbarhed, resiliens, netværk og identitet
* Softwareudvikling og API\-design i Java, Python eller .NET
* GenAI\-komponenter som LLMs, RAG eller agentsystemer – eller et stærkt drive for at lære dem hurtigt


Du tænker i genbrugelige platformkapabiliteter frem for enkeltløsninger, og du reducerer den kognitive belastning for de teams, der bygger ovenpå. Du laver shift\-left på krav fra lovgivning og compliance, så de er indbygget i paved path frem for kontrolleret bagefter.


Vi er åbne for både erfarne profiler og lovende udviklere, som er tidligt i karrieren. Det vigtigste er, at du kan bygge – og tage ansvar.

**Du trives, når du:**

* Tager ejerskab frem for at vente på retning
* Finder løsninger i kompleksitet og usikkerhed
* Prioriterer fremdrift uden at gå på kompromis med kvalitet
* Hellere løser problemet end analyserer, hvorfor det er svært

**Udviklingsmuligheder: Sæt retning for agenter i produktion**
--------------------------------------------------------------

**Du får mulighed for at:**

* Tage større teknisk ansvar i teamet
* Drive løsninger i tæt samarbejde med pengeinstitutterne og forretningsdomænerne
* Være med til at definere arkitektur og standarder for agenter i produktion på tværs af communityet

**Klar til at bygge AI, der bliver brugt?**
-------------------------------------------


Hvis du vil arbejde med GenAI i en kontekst, hvor det skal fungere i virkeligheden \- ikke kun i en demo \- så lad os tage en dialog.

**Velkommen til Bankdata**
--------------------------

*Bankdata bygger software til finanssektoren. Vi er næsten 1100 kolleger på holdet, og vi udvikler digitale produkter, platforme og infrastruktur, som ca. hver tredje dansker, 200\.000 virksomheder og flere tusinde bankansatte bruger hver dag.*

*Vi tror på struktureret personlig udvikling, et solidt kollegialt fællesskab og at ambitiøse medarbejdere med fleksible og bæredygtige arbejdsliv præsterer bedre. Bliv klogere på arbejdslivet i Bankdata* ***her****.*

*Hos Bankdata arbejder vi målrettet med at fremme mangfoldighed og diversitet blandt vores medarbejdere, og vi opfordrer derfor alle uanset kønsidentitet, alder og kulturel baggrund til at søge job hos os.*

jobs.title: Developer
jobs.description:
Du bliver en del af Professional Services (PS) – vores forretningsenhed, der arbejder med digitalisering og teknologiske løsninger inden for ERP, CRM, Microsoft 365, Business Intelligence, Cyber Consultancy, Custom Built Solutions og AI.


I forretningsområdet Custom Built Solutions vil du indgå i vores Products\-team, der udvikler og driver Danmarks førende elektroniske patientjournalsystem til den kommunale tandpleje. Vi søger en full\-stack Developer med særligt fokus på frontend\-udvikling. Samtidig skal du blive motiveret af at arbejde med videreudvikling og forbedring af et veletableret system, som hver dag understøtter arbejdet i den kommunale tandpleje i samarbejde med dygtige kollegaer.


Du bliver tilknyttet vores kontor i Viby eller Nordhavn med mulighed for hjemmearbejde. Du kan dog forvente periodisk mødeaktivitet på begge lokationer.


**Din rolle**  

Som Developer kommer du til at arbejde med videreudvikling og vedligeholdelse af vores system til den kommunale tandpleje. Rollen har primært fokus på frontend\-udvikling og integrationer til øvrige systemer, men du kommer også til at være involveret i prioritering af produktudvikling, test, fejlsøgning og dokumentation sammen med resten af det stærke team omkring produktet. Du vil få et tæt samarbejde med resten af teamet bl.a. bestående af produktkonsulenter, supportere og andre udviklere, hvor alle har et stærkt ønske om at forbedre og styrke systemets funktionaliteter og sikre glade kunder. Vi løfter i fællesskab, og derfor er det væsentligt, at du er en holdspiller.


Derudover kan rollen også indebære dialog og sparring med kunder – både over for tekniske og ikke\-tekniske interessenter. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du trives i rollen som sparringspartner og kan omsætte og formidle tekniske løsninger i et sprog, der giver mening for brugerne og for dine kollegaer i teamet.


Dine primære ansvarsområder dækker over følgende:

* Afdække kundernes forretningsbehov og omsætte dem til tekniske løsninger og systemfunktioner.
* Fejlsøge og forbedre eksisterende integrationer for at sikre stabil dataudveksling.
* Udvikle nye frontend\-funktioner til systemet.
* Vedligeholde og optimere eksisterende kodebase for at sikre stabil drift og høj performance.
* Bidrage til teknisk sparring i forbindelse med design af nye funktioner.
* Udarbejde og gennemføre tests af nye funktioner og integrationer.
* Udarbejde teknisk dokumentation af nye funktioner, integrationer og systemændringer.

**Vi søger en teamm8 der**
  

Ønsker en rolle med fokus på både nyudvikling og vedligeholdelse af et anerkendt system inden for et nicheområde. Derudover ser vi gerne at følgende er opfyldt:

* 3\-5 års erfaring fra en rolle som udvikler særligt med fokus på frontend\-udvikling, hvor du eventuelt har arbejdet med Middleware, Unit\-testing og/eller CI/CD.
* Gerne viden om WinForms, .Net Framework/.Net Core, SQL Server, Git og/eller Azure DevOps.
* Evner at forklare kompleks kode i et sprog som kollegaer og kunder forstår.
* Motiveres i kundedialoger og behovsafdækning, som herefter omsættes til konkrete løsninger.
* Behersker dansk og engelsk både mundtligt og skriftligt.

**Det du får**

* En unik mulighed for at arbejde med softwareudvikling i et nichesystem, der er anerkendt i markedet.
* Mulighed for tage ansvar i en udviklingsrolle af teknisk karakter, hvor du formår at spille systemets brugere gode med rette rådgivning.
* At blive en del af en hybrid arbejdsplads med mulighed for hjemmearbejde.
* Indgå i en kultur med ambitioner, ærlighed og plads til personlig udvikling
* At blive en del af en ambitiøs IT\-koncern med 1600 teamm8s, der hepper på dig.

**Skal du med på holdet?**  

Så ser vi frem til at modtage dit CV.


Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Stefanie Kerstin Krüger Holtum, Manager \- Custom Built Solutions på skkru@itm8\.com. Alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt.


Vi afholder løbende samtaler og afslutter rekrutteringsprocessen, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Vi indhenter straffeattest forud for ansættelse.


Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

 **Om itm8**


Vi er itm8 – vores kunders IT\-mate.


Bag os står 1\.600\+ teammates fordelt på Danmark, Sverige, Filippinerne og Tjekkiet. Med specialister inden for alt fra IT\-sikkerhed og ERP til AI og softwareudvikling.


Men det, der binder os sammen, er ikke kun teknologi. Det er PURPLE POWER – vores måde at arbejde på. Her hjælper vi hinanden først, fejrer det der virker, og skærer igennem bullshit. Vi tror på ambition frem for status quo. Og på at forskellighed gør os stærkere.


Hos os handler det ikke om at være perfekt. Men om at tage ansvar, skabe værdi og udvikle sig – hver dag.  

Så spørg dig selv: Hvad kan du bygge i dag? Hvor kan det tage os i morgen?


Lyder det som dig? Så søg – og bliv vores næste team'm8\.

jobs.title: Dynamics 365 CRM Developer
jobs.description:
Avensys is a reputed global IT professional services company headquartered in Singapore. Our service spectrum includes enterprise solution consulting, business intelligence, business process automation and managed services. Given our decade of success, we have evolved to become one of the top trusted providers in Singapore and service a client base across banking and financial services, insurance, information technology, healthcare, retail and supply chain.
  
  

**Role:** Dynamics 365 CRM Developer
  
  

Primary Purpose
  
  

The CRM Technical Consultant will act as a technical developer and system administrator for Microsoft Dynamics 365 system(s). The individual will be responsible for development and maintenance on Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM platform. The ideal candidate will have sound knowledge in Dynamics CRM entities, workflows, configurations, customization development, integration development, reporting, dashboards, web resources, CRM solution file management, security model and UI development.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

Project Delivery
  
  

* Analyse process/program specifications \& translate specifications to program codes, conforming to program guidelines and programming best practices
* Make changes to configurable items, which include hardware, software, documentation, etc. It covers configuration management planning, configuration identification, configuration controls \& audits
* Develop unit test package, execute tests \& document test results to ensure the quality of the program
* Assist in the integration testing, system testing, User Acceptance Test (UAT) \& implementation activities to fix the reported problems/bugs of the system to ensure the smooth execution of programs in the production environment
* Investigate all reported problems/errors \& initiate amendments \& testing so that the system can operate correctly \& efficiently
* Prepare \& maintain up\-to\-date system documentation.
* Analyse functional requirements to translate into application design using established design methodologies and guidelines
* Ensure codes comply with company security guidelines


Teamwork
  
  

* Work with team lead to ensure design and programme codes conform to architecture and design standards, and that design satisfies functional and system requirements
* Participate in requirements gathering; work with Business Analysts in reviewing and refining functional specifications
* Participate in peer reviews to improve project quality


Requirement
  
  

* Minimum 3 years of experience in developing, implementing and supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM/CE, CRM 2016/2015\.
* Possess relevant system development / maintenance experience using Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM/SharePoint related technologies
* Strong programming skills using the Microsoft CRM SDK, PowerApps, PowerBI, Flow, SSIS, C\#, Web Services, XML, SQL Server, ASP.NET, HTML and JavaScript
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to think out of the box
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics CRM 2013 or later, including configuration and development of processes, plugins and other customizations
* Understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and relational database concepts
* Excellent time management skills, able to meet effort estimates and deadlines
* Customer focused
* Degree in Computer Science / Computer Engineering / Information Technology related field, or IT equivalent
* Able to travel as required


WHAT’S ON OFFER
  
  

You will be remunerated with an excellent base salary and entitled to attractive company benefits. Additionally, you will get the opportunity to enjoy a fun and collaborative work environment, alongside a strong career progression.
  
  

To submit your application, please apply online or submit your CV to ashwak@aven\-sys.com, Your interest will be treated with strict confidentiality.
  
  

CONSULTANT DETAILS
  
  

**Consultant Name :** Ashwak Ahmed
  
  

**Privacy Statement:** Data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only. Personal data provided will be used strictly in accordance with the relevant data protection law and Avensys' privacy policy.

jobs.description:
Job: Digital and IT Developer
 Contract type: Permanent
 Location: Bucharest Romania
 Offer ID: 86380
**Salesforce Junior Developer (CPQ Consultant)**
================================================

**EQUANS**
==========

  

Equans is a world leader in the energy and services sector, with annual revenues of nearly €19,2 billion\* and almost 800,000 projects.

  

Equans has leading positions in Europe, which is the result of the history of energy construction in these countries, and strong presences in North and South America and in Oceania.


With nearly 90,000 highly skilled employees, Equans has a strong geographic footprint, anchored by historic local brands. Equans provides its customers with excellent technical expertise in the design, installation, maintenance and operation of multi\-technical facilities. This know\-how is based on key skills. First of all, in electrical and thermal engineering \- two strong points that help accelerate the reduction of our clients' carbon footprint \- but also in ventilation , refrigeration , mechanics and robotics , fire protection , energy renovation, digital solutions , IT, cyber security and telecommunications .

  

The combination of these expertise allows us to offer efficient and optimized solutions at all stages of the energy chain, from production, storage and transport to usage.

  

To support its wide range of business, Equans is deploying a worldwide multi clouds Salesforce platform dedicated to Customer knowledge, CRM, quotation processing and Field Service activities in an end\-to\-end model.


Equans is now setting up a new team upon the global IT Shared Line of Services “Sales \& Services” to support the growing activities of its Salesforce landscape.

  

*(\*) Turnover 2024 consolidated*

  

SUMMARY OF THE ROLE


A Salesforce CPQ Application Support Consultant is responsible for the stability, maintenance, and continuous optimization of an existing Salesforce CPQ environment. Unlike a "Build" consultant who focuses on initial implementation, the "Run" consultant ensures business continuity and handles recurring operational needs.

  

KEY OBJECTIVES


* System Availability \& Reliability: Ensure the CPQ engine (Quote Line Editor) and Conga Composer are 100% available, especially during high\-pressure periods like month\-end or quarter\-end closing.
* Pricing \& Data Integrity: Guarantee that every quote generated reflects the current, accurate business logic (Price Books, Discount Schedules, Net margin calculation, and Product Rules) with zero margin for error.
* Process Optimization: Identify and resolve friction points in the "Quote\-to\-Cash" flow to ensure sales reps can move from configuration to signature as fast as possible.
* Risk Mitigation: Manage the impact of Salesforce seasonal releases and maintenance patches to ensure no downtime or broken logic in the production environment.
* Operational Excellence: Provide expert\-level troubleshooting for complex logic issues that standard IT support (Pier 1\) cannot handle.
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


* Incident Management \& Support: Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for Salesforce CPQ issues. Troubleshoot and resolve errors related to product configurations, flows, pricing rules, quote line editor, Conga Composer performance.
* Continuous Enhancement: Design and configure minor functional enhancements, such as new product bundles, discount schedules, and price rules, ensuring they don't disrupt existing logic.
* Release Management: Assess the impact of seasonal Salesforce and CPQ / Conga package upgrades. Participate in regression testing and deployment activities using Copado.

jobs.description:
**New software product team \- Automation Edge Applications**

  

**The role**

At Everllence Automation Edge Applications, we are establishing a new software product team in Piraeus, Greece. You will work closely with colleagues in Denmark and engage with customers across Greece and the Mediterranean region.


The team's mission is to develop customer\-facing applications that help vessel crews and shipping companies operate and optimize engine performance more efficiently.

  

  

As a **Full Stack Software Developer**, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining applications that support vessel crews in operating, monitoring, and optimizing engine performance. You will work closely with UX researchers, data specialists, engine experts, and fellow developers to transform customer needs and operational insights into reliable, scalable, and user\-friendly software solutions.


This is a unique opportunity to help shape a newly established product team while benefiting from the support, expertise, and stability of a global engineering organization.

  

  

**What you will be doing**


* Design and build customer\-facing applications that improve troubleshooting and help vessel crews operate engines effectively.
* Develop end\-to\-end features using C\# or Python on the backend and Node.js, React, and our QUILT application framework on the frontend.
* Turn input from users, UX research, and engine specialists into well\-defined technical solutions and iterative product releases.
* Define maintainable application architectures, APIs, data flows, and reusable user interface components.
* Design software for the realities of onboard environments, including intermittent connectivity, limited computing resources, and software that cannot always be updated immediately.
* Build quality into products through automated testing, code reviews, secure development practices, and useful diagnostics.
* Own features throughout their lifecycle, from technical design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting in collaboration with colleagues across locations.
* Collaborate closely with UX researchers, data scientists, domain experts, and fellow developers throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Utilize AI\-assisted development tools and emerging technologies where they create value while maintaining accountability for software quality, security, and reliability.
  

  

**Who you are**


You are a pragmatic software developer who enjoys turning complex operational requirements into simple, dependable solutions for end users.

  

  

**Ideally, You Bring**


* Professional experience delivering full stack web applications and taking features from idea to production.
* Strong skills in C\#, Python, TypeScript, or similar technologies, with experience in modern backend development.
* Experience working with Node.js and React or comparable frontend frameworks.
* Experience designing APIs, integrating data sources, and working with version control and continuous integration practices.
* Experience with containerization such as Docker.
* A quality\-focused approach that includes automated testing, maintainability, security, observability, and production support.
* The ability to explain technical trade\-offs and collaborate effectively with UX researchers, domain specialists, and fellow developers.
* Experience within maritime, industrial, manufacturing, energy, edge\-computing, or other operational environments is considered an advantage, but not required.
* Proficiency in English language.

You are curious, constructive, and comfortable working in a newly established team where priorities may evolve as we learn from customers. You balance speed with sound engineering judgment and understand that software used aboard a vessel must be reliable, secure, and supportable.

  

  

**Benefits \& Learning Opportunities**


* Flexible working arrangements, including the possibility to work from home 2\-3 days per week after the initial onboarding period of three months, subject to manager agreement and business requirements.
* Attractive compensation package
* Continuous training opportunities
* Work in a challenging multinational environment
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement
  

  

**Welcome to Everllence Greece and the Automation Edge Application Team**

You will be joining our Automation Edge Applications team, consisting of 21 colleagues, including software developers, engineers, designers, and product managers. The team is responsible for designing and developing the digital products used by vessel crews when operating and optimizing our engines.


The team is primarily located in Denmark and works closely with an additional team of 12 colleagues based in India.


The Automation Edge Applications team is part of the Automation function within Everllence R\&D, an organization of approximately 160 professionals responsible for the electronic control systems of our engines.


You will be based in our established hub in Piraeus, Greece, and become part of the local Software Engineering organization, where colleagues contribute to a variety of global software and digitalization initiatives across Everllence.


While your day\-to\-day work will be closely connected to the international Edge Applications team, you will also benefit from being part of a local engineering community and collaborating with professionals across the Piraeus site.

  

  

**About The Team's Mission**


The team is focused on creating customer value by combining user research, customer insights, data\-driven analysis, and software development.


The goal is to engage directly with customers, both onboard vessels and in shore\-based operations, and transform their needs into valuable digital products. These solutions may help improve troubleshooting, optimize engine performance in relation to other onboard systems, or provide actionable insights through data analytics for shipping companies.


While this role focuses on UX research and design, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary team where different competencies come together to deliver customer\-centric solutions.

  

  

**What you should know about us**

Everllence, , enables it customers to achieve sustainable value creation in the transition towards a carbon neutral future. Addressing tomorrow's challenges within the marine, energy and industrial sectors, we improve efficiency and performance at a systematic level. Leading the way in advanced engineering for more than 250 years, we provide a unique portfolio of technologies. Headquartered in Germany, Everllence employs some 15,000 people at over 120 sites globally. Our after sales brand, Everllence PrimeServ offers a vast network of service centers to our customers all over the world.


EVERLLENCE Hellas has been active in the Greek market since 1966 and we operate in Piraeus, Perama and Limassol (Cyprus). Our main areas of expertise is: Νew Sales, Αfter Sales services (Spare Parts and Technical), Data Processing, Engineering Services, PrimeServ Academy.

  

  

**That is important to us**

Integrity and compliance are essential elements of our corporate culture. We firmly support diversity and equal opportunities and are therefore looking forward to receiving a diverse range of online applications.


We look for energetic and keen people, excited to join a dynamic international company.


**Only completed applications submitted in English will be considered.** The screening process of applications will proceed on ongoing basis. We will close the position as soon as a suitable candidate is found


\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_


At Everllence Hellas, each employee makes a significant contribution to the overall performance of the company as well as to customer’s satisfaction.


With a strong focus on decarbonization, digitization and innovative solutions, we look for job applicants who value Integrity, who are seeking to leverage their skills and expertise as well as are self\-motivated to make the difference.

jobs.title: Applied AI Architect
jobs.description:
**About Kairostek**
===================


At Kairostek, we believe great technology starts with great people.


We foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth, empowering our team to make a meaningful impact while building solutions that shape the future. Our teams work across software engineering, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, digital products, payments technology, and technology operations to deliver scalable and innovative solutions for global organizations.


If you are passionate about technology, problem\-solving, and continuous learning, we would love to hear from you.

**About the Role**
==================


As an Applied AI Architect, you will be the trusted technical advisor for how AI gets built and used across Kairostek. Your customers are our own product development squads and business teams. You will help them see where large language models can create real value, and then guide them from first idea to a reliable service running in production.


This is a hands\-on role. You will work closely with our Agentics squad, building prototypes and proofs of concept yourself, writing near\-production reference code, and designing the evaluation frameworks that tell us whether an AI feature is ready to ship. Alongside that, you will turn what works into reusable blueprints, patterns, and training that every squad can pick up.


Working with Engineering, you will set the architecture, standards, and guardrails for AI, so that teams can move quickly without taking on unmanaged risk.


You will report directly to, and work closely with, our VP of Development \& AI. Together you will shape the department's AI strategy and roadmap, decide where to invest, and turn that direction into architecture and delivery across the squads.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Partner with squad leads and stakeholders to understand their problems and translate them into practical AI solutions, keeping business outcomes and technical design aligned
* Act as the primary technical advisor for AI adoption across the department, coordinating across teams to get use cases delivered
* Ship working code: build prototypes and proofs of concept, develop evaluation frameworks, and write reference implementations that squads can take to production
* Design and own the reference architecture for LLM applications and agentic workflows, covering model selection, orchestration, retrieval, tool integration, and deployment
* Guide squads on integrating AI into our existing Java, .NET, Node.js, and React platforms, including APIs, event streams, and tool protocols such as MCP
* Help teams build evaluation frameworks that measure quality, latency, and cost for their specific use cases, and keep them from regressing over time
* Define security, privacy, and governance standards for AI use, including data handling, access control, prompt injection defence, and auditability
* Develop reusable blueprints, demos, and enablement material that scale across squads, and run workshops for engineers and non\-technical stakeholders
* Identify common patterns and gaps across use cases and feed them back into our platform, tooling, and vendor decisions
* Stay current with developments in models, agent frameworks, and implementation practice, and bring the useful parts into how we work

**Qualifications \& Experience**
================================

* 5\+ years of highly technical experience as a software engineer, solutions architect, or equivalent, with hands\-on experience shipping LLM\-based applications
* A builder mentality: you have shipped real software, you care about craftsmanship, and you have good technical judgement
* Systems thinking: you would rather build one solution that serves ten teams than ten solutions that each serve one
* Strong coding ability in Python, with regular prototype delivery and experience working in real production codebases
* Practical experience with RAG, vector databases, embeddings, agent orchestration, and common LLM frameworks and tools
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and integrating with existing enterprise systems
* The ability to build trust with engineers and explain complicated topics clearly to leaders and non\-technical teams
* Comfort working in ambiguous, early\-stage areas and building structure as you go
* Skill at working across teams, navigating trade\-offs and competing priorities
* A teaching and mentoring mindset, and a genuine interest in helping others succeed with AI
* A passion for using AI in ways that are safe, responsible, and beneficial

**Strong Candidates May Also Have:**

* Background in iGaming, fintech, payments, or cryptocurrency platforms
* Experience applying AI in regulated environments, with awareness of AML, KYC, GDPR, or PCI\-DSS requirements
* Hands\-on experience with the Model Context Protocol, coding agents, and AI\-assisted software delivery
* Experience with LLMOps tooling, observability for non\-deterministic systems, and cost optimisation at scale
* A background in data engineering, ML engineering, or data science

**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive compensation package.
* Flexible and remote\-friendly work environment.
* Professional growth and development opportunities.
* Exposure to international projects and teams.
* Collaborative and inclusive company culture.
* Opportunity to work with modern technologies and innovative solutions.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
==============================


Kairostek is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or background.

**About Equans Digital Airport Systems (EDAS)**


Equans Digital Airport Systems (EDAS) is the BHS (Baggage Handling System) software unit within Equans Belux. We design, develop, deploy, and maintain mission\-critical software solutions for airport baggage handling systems worldwide — serving airports across Europe, North America, Africa, and the Middle East.


As part of Equans ICT, we combine deep domain expertise in airport logistics with modern software engineering practices. We are currently undertaking a significant transformation program focused on software stabilization, CI/CD automation, remote access platform development, and test environment modernization — you will be joining at an exciting time of technical renewal.

* Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het verder uitbouwen en beheren van de salespipeline en draagt actief bij aan omzetgroei via een doordachte verkoop\-, prijs\- en marktstrategie.
* Je begeleidt partners doorheen het volledige verkoopproces en helpt mogelijke commerciële of operationele obstakels weg te nemen om projecten succesvol te realiseren.
* Je werkt mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de go\-to\-marketstrategie van de BESS\-oplossingen. Samen met het marketingteam versterk je de marktpositie en commerciële aanwezigheid van de organisatie.
* Je werkt nauw samen met het managementteam en levert vanuit de markt en klantencontacten waardevolle input voor de commerciële strategie en verdere productontwikkeling.
  

Jouw profiel


* Je hebt een sterke commerciële achtergrond in business development, sales of een gelijkaardige functie binnen de energiesector of een aanverwante technische omgeving.
* Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het uitbouwen van strategische partnerships, en je bent sterk in commerciële onderhandelingen en stakeholdermanagement, en weet verschillende stakeholders op een professionele manier te verbinden en te overtuigen.
* Je hebt een sterke interesse in BESS, energietransitie en innovatieve technologieën.
* Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels. Kennis van het Frans is een pluspunt.
* Een Masterdiploma in economie, ingenieurswetenschappen of een gelijkaardige richting is een troef, net als ervaring met MS Excel, AI\-tools en/of Odoo.

jobs.title: C# Middle Analyst Developer
jobs.description:
Join Axians, where innovation thrives on trust and autonomy, and where every challenge is an opportunity to create technology with impact.

**C\# .NET Developer**

**What We Are Looking For**


We are looking for an experienced C\# .NET Developer to join an international project in a dynamic and multicultural environment.


In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, maintenance, and modernization of business\-critical applications, working closely with technical and functional teams in an Agile environment. You will play an active role throughout the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and solution design to implementation, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement.


You will help deliver scalable, reliable, and high\-quality software solutions while contributing to the evolution of existing systems and the adoption of development best practices.

**What You Will Do on a Daily Basis**

* Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Design, develop, and maintain applications using C\# and .NET technologies.
* Contribute to software architecture and technical design activities.
* Maintain and improve existing applications, ensuring high performance and reliability.
* Implement new functionalities following development best practices.
* Develop and execute unit tests to ensure application quality.
* Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Work closely with business and technical stakeholders throughout project lifecycles.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application issues and production incidents.
* Create and maintain technical documentation.
* Contribute to Agile/SCRUM ceremonies and team objectives.
* Ensure compliance with development standards, coding guidelines, and quality practices.

**Your Key Skills**

* C\# .NET Development.
* SQL Server.
* Angular.

**Your Main Qualifications**

* Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in software development.
* Strong experience with C\# and .NET technologies.
* Solid understanding of the full software development lifecycle.
* Experience designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise applications.
* Experience with relational databases, preferably SQL Server.
* Knowledge of Angular or similar web development frameworks.
* Experience with Design Patterns and Dependency Injection.
* Knowledge of Test\-Driven Development (TDD).
* Experience with Git and/or SVN version control systems.
* Ability to analyze legacy applications and contribute to modernization initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills.
* Experience working in Agile and Scrum environments.
* Fluency in English.

**What We Offer**

**Stable professional career**


Working with Axians projects becomes an asset to those of us who want to offer stability through a secure career.

**Prospects for career advancement**


You can access training and new certifications that will further elevate your skills. The 360° evaluation from managers and peers will also allow you to evolve.

**Work Life Balance**


By collaborating with Axians, you will be able to reconcile work and family requirements without neglecting either area.

**Attractive, evolving compensation**


When working with Axians, you will have access to performance bonuses in addition to an attractive salary pack (base salary \+ benefits). You are also entitled to health insurance and an employee assistance program for you and your family (Psychological, Legal, Psychosocial, and Financial support).


Axians is the VINCI Energies brand dedicated to Information Technology and Digital Transformation. With an international presence and a people\-to\-people approach, we combine technology, innovation, and proximity to create real impact for organizations and society.

**Join Axians**


At Axians, we believe that talent does not fit a single profile. We value diversity and promote an inclusive environment where everyone has the opportunity to grow and contribute. If you have a disability or impairment, we are committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout the recruitment and onboarding process. Whenever needed, we provide reasonable accommodations so that you can participate on an equal basis. If you require any accommodation, please let us know by contacting us at **recrutamento.axianspt@axians.com**.

jobs.title: Desenvolvedor de Sistemas – Full Stack - SR - 1 - C#
jobs.description:
#### **Sobre o trabalho Desenvolvedor de Sistemas – Full Stack \- SR \- 1 \- C\#**


**Venha fazer parte de um ecossistema vivo onde o futuro dos negócios é criado e vivido todos os dias. Faça parte desta transformação!**



Na LUZA Group, a paixão, a perseverança e a vontade de superar limites definem o nosso caminho para o sucesso.



Fundada em 2006, somos uma multinacional portuguesa com mais de 1\.200 profissionais talentosos e um volume de negócios. Com presença em mercados estratégicos como Portugal, Espanha, Marrocos, Brasil, México, Estados Unidos e China, oferecemos soluções inovadoras em engenharia, TI, design, consultoria, Indústria 4\.0, treinamento e recrutamento. Tudo o que fazemos é movido pelo talento de nosso povo.


**Este é um momento de crescimento e oportunidade. O futuro pertence a mentes visionárias. Junte\-se a nós!**


**Requisitos:**  

**Atuar como referência técnica na definição da arquitetura corporativa de identidade digital, suportando decisões de autenticação, autorização, governança de identidades e integração entre plataformas.**  

**Analisar, desenhar e implementar soluções de IAM e CIAM.**  

**Desenhar fluxos de autenticação, autorização e gestão do ciclo de vida de identidades.**  

**Desenvolver e evoluir APIs, microserviços e componentes de segurança.**  

**Definir padrões técnicos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento seguro (SSDLC).**  

**Realizar integrações síncronas e assíncronas com plataformas internas e externas via APIs, eventos e mensageria.**  

**Participar de refinamentos técnicos, requisitos não funcionais e revisões de arquitetura.**  

**Contribuir para a esteira DevSecOps e para a qualidade de software.**  

**Apoiar a resolução de incidentes complexos e análises de causa raiz.**  

**Atuar como referência em identidade digital, autenticação e segurança de aplicações.**  

  

**Requisitos obrigatórios — Desenvolvimento e Arquitetura**  

**Experiência como Analista de Sistemas, Desenvolvedor Sênior ou funções correlatas.**  

**Domínio de C\# e ecossistema .NET.**  

**Desenvolvimento de APIs REST e microserviços.**  

**Padrões de integração corporativa (Enterprise Integration Patterns).**  

**Integrações síncronas e assíncronas; gRPC e Message Brokers.**  

**Arquitetura orientada a eventos (Event\-Driven) e Kafka (produção e consumo).**  

**Ciclo completo de desenvolvimento (SDLC).**  

**Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, DDD, CQRS, Mediator Pattern, Event Sourcing (desejável) e arquiteturas distribuídas.**  

**Modelagem de dados / Entidade\-Relacionamento; bancos Oracle e Redis.**  

  

**Requisitos obrigatórios — Identidade Digital (núcleo da vaga)**  

**Experiência comprovada em implementação, customização ou sustentação de ao menos uma plataforma IAM/CIAM corporativa (ex.: ForgeRock, Ping Identity, SailPoint, Saviynt, Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, Auth0 ou Okta).**  

**Domínio avançado de protocolos e padrões: OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML 2\.0, JWT, SCIM, Federation e Single Sign\-On (SSO).**  

**Gestão de ciclo de vida de identidades; provisionamento e desprovisionamento; RBAC; ABAC; gestão de privilégios; Segregação de Funções (SoD); governança de acessos; MFA.**

Requisitos:  

Domínio da linguagem C\#
  

Sintaxe moderna (C\# 9\+ ou superior)
  

Tipos de dados, coleções, LINQ
  

Programação orientada a objetos (OO)
  

Programação assíncrona (async/await, Tasks, paralelismo)
  

Manipulação de exceções
  

Reflection e atributos
  

.NET / .NET Core
  

Criação de APIs REST com ASP.NET Core
  

Middlewares
  

Dependency Injection nativa
  

Versionamento de APIs
  

Autenticação e Autorização (JWT, Claims, Policies)
  

Configurações e ambientes (appsettings, variáveis de ambiente)
  

Acesso a Dados
  

Entity Framework Core
  

Mapeamento ORM
  

Migrations
  

Consultas LINQ avançadas
  

Estratégias de tracking, performance e otimização
  

Conhecimento de Oracle / SQL Server
  

Criação de queries
  

Stored procedures
  

Transações
  

Arquitetura e Boas Práticas de Backend
  

\+ Design de software
  

Arquitetura limpa (Clean Architecture)
  

SOLID
  

Domain\-Driven Design (conceitos principais)
  

Padrões de projeto (Repository, Factory, Adapter, Strategy etc.)


Angular – Desenvolvimento Frontend Avançado
  

\+ Fundamentos do Angular
  

Estrutura do framework
  

Módulos, componentes e serviços
  

Data binding (one\-way, two\-way)
  

Diretivas (ngIf, ngFor, ngSwitch, custom)
  

Pipes nativos e personalizados


\+ Arquitetura Frontend
  

RxJS e programação reativa (Observables, Subjects, Operators)
  

Gerenciamento de estado (RxJS puro, NGXS, NGRX)
  

Reutilização de componentes
  

Comunicação entre componentes e serviços


\+ Ferramentas e Ecossistema
  

Git (branching strategies, pull requests, code review)
  

Visual Studio / VS Code
  

Postman / Swagger
  

Node.js e NPM
  

Compreensão de REST e desenvolvimento orientado a contratos (OpenAPI)
  

  

\+ Metodologias e Colaboração Técnica
  

(Ainda Hard Skills, por envolver uso de ferramentas)


Um desenvolvedor que domina C\# \+ Angular precisa combinar habilidades de:


Backend robusto com .NET
  

Frontend moderno com Angular
  

Arquitetura limpa e boas práticas
  

Segurança e qualidade de código
  

Domínio de ferramentas de deploy e colaboração  

Scrum / Kanban
  

Documentação técnica (Markdown, Diagrams, Swagger)
  

Story slicing e entendimento de requisitos técnicos

jobs.description:
#### **Sobre o trabalho Desenvolvedor de Sistemas – Full Stack \- SR \- 1**


**Venha fazer parte de um ecossistema vivo onde o futuro dos negócios é criado e vivido todos os dias. Faça parte desta transformação!**



Na LUZA Group, a paixão, a perseverança e a vontade de superar limites definem o nosso caminho para o sucesso.



Fundada em 2006, somos uma multinacional portuguesa com mais de 1\.200 profissionais talentosos e um volume de negócios. Com presença em mercados estratégicos como Portugal, Espanha, Marrocos, Brasil, México, Estados Unidos e China, oferecemos soluções inovadoras em engenharia, TI, design, consultoria, Indústria 4\.0, treinamento e recrutamento. Tudo o que fazemos é movido pelo talento de nosso povo.


**Este é um momento de crescimento e oportunidade. O futuro pertence a mentes visionárias. Junte\-se a nós!**


**Requisitos:**  

**Atuar como referência técnica na definição da arquitetura corporativa de identidade digital, suportando decisões de autenticação, autorização, governança de identidades e integração entre plataformas.**  

**Analisar, desenhar e implementar soluções de IAM e CIAM.**  

**Desenhar fluxos de autenticação, autorização e gestão do ciclo de vida de identidades.**  

**Desenvolver e evoluir APIs, microserviços e componentes de segurança.**  

**Definir padrões técnicos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento seguro (SSDLC).**  

**Realizar integrações síncronas e assíncronas com plataformas internas e externas via APIs, eventos e mensageria.**  

**Participar de refinamentos técnicos, requisitos não funcionais e revisões de arquitetura.**  

**Contribuir para a esteira DevSecOps e para a qualidade de software.**  

**Apoiar a resolução de incidentes complexos e análises de causa raiz.**  

**Atuar como referência em identidade digital, autenticação e segurança de aplicações.**  

  

**Requisitos obrigatórios — Desenvolvimento e Arquitetura**  

**Experiência como Analista de Sistemas, Desenvolvedor Sênior ou funções correlatas.**  

**Domínio de C\# e ecossistema .NET.**  

**Desenvolvimento de APIs REST e microserviços.**  

**Padrões de integração corporativa (Enterprise Integration Patterns).**  

**Integrações síncronas e assíncronas; gRPC e Message Brokers.**  

**Arquitetura orientada a eventos (Event\-Driven) e Kafka (produção e consumo).**  

**Ciclo completo de desenvolvimento (SDLC).**  

**Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, DDD, CQRS, Mediator Pattern, Event Sourcing (desejável) e arquiteturas distribuídas.**  

**Modelagem de dados / Entidade\-Relacionamento; bancos Oracle e Redis.**  

  

**Requisitos obrigatórios — Identidade Digital (núcleo da vaga)**  

**Experiência comprovada em implementação, customização ou sustentação de ao menos uma plataforma IAM/CIAM corporativa (ex.: ForgeRock, Ping Identity, SailPoint, Saviynt, Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, Auth0 ou Okta).**  

**Domínio avançado de protocolos e padrões: OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML 2\.0, JWT, SCIM, Federation e Single Sign\-On (SSO).**  

**Gestão de ciclo de vida de identidades; provisionamento e desprovisionamento; RBAC; ABAC; gestão de privilégios; Segregação de Funções (SoD); governança de acessos; MFA.**  

  

**Requisitos obrigatórios — Segurança da Informação**  

**Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) e OWASP Top 10\.**  

**Criptografia simétrica e assimétrica, hash, password hash, assinatura digital e certificados digitais.**  

**Conceitos de autenticação multifator (MFA).**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — Identidade Moderna**  

**FIDO2, Passkeys, WebAuthn, Device Binding.**  

**Adaptive Authentication e Risk\-Based Authentication.**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — Governança (IGA)**  

**Access Review e recertificação de acessos.**  

**Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver, Birthright Access, Role Mining e Entitlement Management.**  

**Identity Governance and Administration (IGA).**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — PAM**  

**Privileged Access Management, gestão de contas privilegiadas e segregação de acessos administrativos.**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — Nuvem**  

**IAM cloud\-native em Azure, AWS ou GCP; Secrets Management, Managed Identities e federação entre ambientes.**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — Observabilidade**  

**OpenTelemetry, Distributed Tracing, observabilidade aplicada a autenticação, SIEM e monitoramento de fraudes de autenticação.**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — Contexto regulatório**  

**Experiência em ambientes regulados: instituições financeiras, cooperativas de crédito, seguradoras, fintechs ou meios de pagamento.**

  


Soft Skills \- Descreva detalhadamente as habilidades interpessoais necessárias:Capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas complexos: aptidão para compreender cenários de integração complexos, identificar causas raiz e propor soluções escaláveis e seguras.



Visão sistêmica e pensamento arquitetural: capacidade de entender impactos entre múltiplos sistemas, aplicações, processos de negócio e requisitos de segurança.



Comunicação eficaz: habilidade para traduzir conceitos técnicos para públicos não técnicos e atuar como ponte entre equipes de tecnologia, segurança, arquitetura, fornecedores e áreas de negócio.



Autonomia e senso de propriedade (ownership): capacidade de conduzir iniciativas de ponta a ponta, assumindo responsabilidade pelos resultados e atuando com baixa necessidade de supervisão.



Colaboração e trabalho em equipe: facilidade para atuar em ambientes multidisciplinares, colaborando com times de desenvolvimento, arquitetura, infraestrutura, segurança e produtos digitais.



Orientação a resultados: foco na entrega de valor para o negócio, priorizando atividades críticas e mantendo o equilíbrio entre agilidade, qualidade e segurança.



Adaptabilidade e aprendizado contínuo: disposição para acompanhar a rápida evolução das tecnologias de identidade, autenticação, APIs, nuvem e segurança.



Capacidade de influência e negociação: habilidade para conduzir discussões técnicas, alinhar interesses entre diferentes áreas e promover a adoção de boas práticas de identidade e acesso.



Mentalidade de segurança (Security by Design): preocupação constante em incorporar requisitos de segurança desde a concepção das integrações e soluções.
